title: Sr. Desenvolvimento Cloud
description:
Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!

Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.

Certificada pelo 7º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília

Requisitos

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento para nuvem
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento Java
  • Experiência em Angular (versões 6 a 9)
  • Experiência em API Rest
  • Experiência em Testes Unitários, Integrados, API, Front
  • Experiência em Docker
  • Conhecimento de Kubernetes
  • Experiência em Banco de dados Relacional
  • Conhecimento em Banco de dados NoSQL
  • Experiência em Metodologias Ágeis

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento de Ferramentas de Monitoração (Prometheus, Grafana, AppDynamics, OpenTelemetry)
  • Conhecimento de modelagem para microsserviços
  • Conhecimento de DDD – Domain Driven Design

Benefícios e Incentivos

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília

Para Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico SulAmérica extensivo a dependentes;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição em cartão flexível Caju benefícios
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Auxílio Home-Office em cartão flexível Caju benefícios;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Sesc – extensivo a dependentes, com acesso aos serviços em todo o Brasil;
  • TotalPass.

Para o seu Desenvolvimento:

  • ília University: Universidade Corporativa com mais de 20 mil cursos disponíveis para desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional;
  • Language Academy: Escola de idiomas para ílians;
  • í-talks e Chapter: Momentos e cerimônias em que o time compartilha práticas, estudos, projetos e ideias. Nas chapters ainda se reúnem pessoas com skills similares para compartilhamento de ideias, práticas e experiências;

Gostamos de ir além no cuidado com as nossas pessoas, então dispomos também de alguns benefícios não convencionais:

  • Plano de Saúde PET - Guapeco
  • Onhappy – benefício de viagem a lazer, com liberdade para você viajar com quem quiser.
  • BYOD - Alugamos o seu notebook pessoal te pagando um valor mensal para que você o use, mas disponibilizamos também máquinas de trabalho para ílians. Você quem decide!
  • Seu Niver, seu bolo!
  • Seu Networking Vale Prêmio - Programa de premiação a indicação de novos funcionários.

title: Monitor (a) de Pesquisa Pleno - CRA II
description:
OBJETIVO DA POSIÇÃO


Gerenciar os centros de pesquisa de um determinado estudo e realizar monitoria dos centros de pesquisa do Brasil e/ou LATAM. Suporte aos monitores CRA I.


PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES:


  • Realizar visitas de monitoria on-site ou remotas (visitas de seleção, iniciação, periódicas e encerramento) de acordo com o escopo de trabalho contratado e os requisitos regulatórios, ou seja, as diretrizes de Boas Práticas Clínicas (GCP) e da Conferência Internacional de Harmonização (ICH).
  • Trabalhar com os centros para adaptar, impulsionar e rastrear o plano de recrutamento dos participantes de acordo com as necessidades do projeto para aumentar a previsibilidade.
  • Administrar protocolo e treinamento de estudo relacionado aos centros designados e estabelecer linhas regulares de comunicação com os centros para gerenciar expectativas e problemas contínuos do projeto.
  • Avaliar a qualidade e integridade das práticas do centro relacionadas à condução adequada do protocolo e adesão aos regulamentos aplicáveis. Escalar problemas de qualidade conforme apropriado.
  • Gerenciar o progresso dos estudos atribuídos rastreando submissões e aprovações regulatórias, recrutamento e elegibilidade, preenchimento da CRF e geração e resolução de queries.
  • Certificar-se de que cópias/originais (conforme necessário) dos documentos do centro estejam disponíveis para arquivamento no TMF e verificar se o ISF é mantido de acordo com GCP/ICH e requisitos regulatórios locais.
  • Criar e manter documentação apropriada relativa ao gerenciamento do centro, monitorar resultados de visitas e planos de ação, enviando relatórios de monitoria, gerando cartas de acompanhamento e outra documentação de estudo necessária.
  • Desenvolver materiais como plano de monitoria, apresentação de SIV, Newsletter e ferramentas para auxílio no processo de suas atividades, auxílio em processo contratual, apresentações em meeting de investigadores.
  • Colaborar e estabelecer ligação com os membros da equipe de estudo para apoio à execução do projeto, conforme apropriado.
  • Se aplicável, ser responsável pela gestão financeira do centro.
  • Atuar como mentor dos CRA I, incluindo a realização de visitas de co-monitoria e treinamento.


REQUISITOS DA POSIÇÃO:

- Formação Acadêmica

Graduação na Área da Saúde (Farmácia, Fisioterapia, Enfermagem, Biologia, Biomedicina, entre outras), pós-graduação na área preferencialmente, formação em pesquisa clínica


- Requisitos Técnicos:

Disponibilidade para viajar pelo menos 60% do tempo.


- Experiência:

Pelo menos 18 meses de experiência em pesquisa, experiência prévia em monitoria.


- Idiomas (Opcional):

Inglês: Avançado.

Espanhol necessário para monitores LATAM.


- Soft Skills:

  • Trabalho em equipe
  • Adaptabilidade
  • Proatividade
  • Boa comunicação
  • Gerenciamento do tempo
  • Relacionamento interpessoal
  • Coerência

title: Ruby Consultant
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.

About the opportunity:

Long-term contract

Remote

Senior Fullstack Engineer

What You Get To Do Every Day

- Produce high-quality, performant, and testable code that directly contributes to company-wide initiatives

- Develop using interesting technologies -- Elixir, Ruby, React, Typescript, GraphQL, Kafka, AWS/Lambda, PostgreSQL, DynamoDB

- Have significant input into technical decisions that will shape the future of our software systems

- Learn something new, whether its a new software design pattern or new initiative to push the company forward

- Review pull requests and provide constructive feedback to your peers - Pair up with a team member to work together on features

- Deploy user-facing code to production

✅ Skills/Experience

- What You Bring To The Role

- 5+ years professional software development experience - Fluency with either Elixir or Ruby

- Proficient with the latest versions of ECMAScript (JavaScript) as well as HTML and CSS

- Experience with React and common tools used in the wider React ecosystem, such as Node.js and npm

- Familiarity with common programming tools such as IDEs, RESTful APIs, Git repositories, TypeScript, version control software, and remote deployment tools

- Familiarity with event based architectures, database fundamentals and GraphQL

- Enthusiasm for solving problems for our users with technology

- Curiosity about retail/e-commerce, the high-end consignment market, and/or how to create a sustainable, circular economy for luxury goods

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Senior Machine Learning Engineer – Decision Intelligence & Advanced Analytics

Contract: 6–12 months (with possible extension)

Engagement Model: Independent Contractor (PJ)

Time Zone: Must be available to work in Eastern Time (ET)

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to drive performance measurement and build scalable, production-grade analytical solutions within a high-velocity supply chain environment.

This role goes beyond model experimentation. The ideal candidate must be capable of designing end-to-end decision intelligence solutions, from data modeling and advanced analytics to business impact measurement and stakeholder adoption.

You will operate in a fast-paced production ecosystem where reliability, scalability, and measurable business outcomes are critical.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement advanced analytics and AI/ML solutions to optimize supply chain performance.
  • Develop performance measurement frameworks aligned with business KPIs.
  • Build automated, production-ready analytical pipelines.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to translate business problems into scalable data solutions.
  • Ensure high standards of code quality, testing, documentation, and model governance.
  • Drive stakeholder adoption by clearly communicating insights and quantifying business impact.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience in advanced analytics, decision science, and applied AI/ML.
  • Advanced programming skills in Python and SQL .
  • Hands-on experience deploying AI/ML solutions in cloud environments (GCP, Azure, Databricks).
  • Experience with modern data platforms and analytics engineering (Snowflake or similar cloud data warehouses).
  • Familiarity with BI and visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, ThoughtSpot).
  • Experience working in production-grade environments with scalable data systems.
  • Strong product mindset and experience delivering solutions using agile methodologies.
  • Proven ability to quantify business value and align analytical solutions with strategic objectives.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders.

What We’re Looking For

  • Someone comfortable operating in ambiguity.
  • A professional who understands the difference between building models and driving decisions.
  • A data scientist who prioritizes measurable impact over academic experimentation.
  • A collaborator who can influence stakeholders and drive adoption across business teams.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Senior Machine Learning Engineer – Decision Intelligence & Advanced Analytics

Contract: 6–12 months (with possible extension)

Engagement Model: Independent Contractor (PJ)

Time Zone: Must be available to work in Eastern Time (ET)

Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to drive performance measurement and build scalable, production-grade analytical solutions within a high-velocity supply chain environment.

This role goes beyond model experimentation. The ideal candidate must be capable of designing end-to-end decision intelligence solutions, from data modeling and advanced analytics to business impact measurement and stakeholder adoption.

You will operate in a fast-paced production ecosystem where reliability, scalability, and measurable business outcomes are critical.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement advanced analytics and AI/ML solutions to optimize supply chain performance.
  • Develop performance measurement frameworks aligned with business KPIs.
  • Build automated, production-ready analytical pipelines.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to translate business problems into scalable data solutions.
  • Ensure high standards of code quality, testing, documentation, and model governance.
  • Drive stakeholder adoption by clearly communicating insights and quantifying business impact.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience in advanced analytics, decision science, and applied AI/ML.
  • Advanced programming skills in Python and SQL .
  • Hands-on experience deploying AI/ML solutions in cloud environments (GCP, Azure, Databricks).
  • Experience with modern data platforms and analytics engineering (Snowflake or similar cloud data warehouses).
  • Familiarity with BI and visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, ThoughtSpot).
  • Experience working in production-grade environments with scalable data systems.
  • Strong product mindset and experience delivering solutions using agile methodologies.
  • Proven ability to quantify business value and align analytical solutions with strategic objectives.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders.

What We’re Looking For

  • Someone comfortable operating in ambiguity.
  • A professional who understands the difference between building models and driving decisions.
  • A data scientist who prioritizes measurable impact over academic experimentation.
  • A collaborator who can influence stakeholders and drive adoption across business teams.

title: Analista de Dados (Engenharia & Integração SAP)
description:
Analista de Dados (Engenharia & Integração SAP)


100% Remoto

PJ


Estamos em busca de um Analista de Dados para atuar diretamente na migração e descomissionamento de sistemas SAP (ECC → S/4HANA) , apoiando o time de Engenharia e Arquitetura de Dados.


O profissional será responsável por executar atividades práticas de integração, mapeamento e migração de dados, garantindo qualidade e rastreabilidade em todo o processo.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Apoiar o processo de migração de dados entre os ambientes SAP ECC e S/4HANA.
  • Realizar o mapeamento de origens, transformações e regras de negócio utilizando SAP Data Services (DS) .
  • Conduzir análises de dados e validações de qualidade para garantir consistência e completude.
  • Executar atividades de integração com SAP SLT (fontes S/4) e DS (fontes ECC) .
  • Colaborar com o time técnico na construção de pipelines e processos de carga para o Data Lake (Databricks, Synapse, Azure SQL) .
  • Documentar processos, tabelas e fluxos de dados, assegurando rastreabilidade e governança.
  • Apoiar a equipe no descomissionamento dos ambientes legados.


Atividades práticas do dia a dia:

  • Desenvolver e ajustar jobs no SAP Data Services .
  • Mapear tabelas de origem SAP e relacionar com os destinos no ambiente cloud.
  • Criar documentação e planilhas de mapeamento e data lineage.
  • Fazer testes de extração, transformação e carga, acompanhando logs e performance.
  • Participar de checkpoints técnicos com equipe de Engenharia e Coordenação.
  • Apoiar análises de erros, inconsistências e ajustes nas integrações.


Experiências desejáveis:

  • Experiência anterior com SAP Data Services (DS) e integrações SAP ECC / S/4HANA .
  • Conhecimento em integrações SLT e fluxos de replicação entre sistemas SAP.
  • Vivência em projetos de migração ou descomissionamento de sistemas SAP .
  • Desejável conhecimento em Databricks, Synapse ou Azure SQL .
  • Perfil hands on, analítico e proativo , com boa organização e atenção a detalhes.
  • Disponibilidade para início imediato (ASAP) .

title: Accountant (with Advanced English)
description:
About the Product

Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them. We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply.

Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.

About the Role

The Associate Staff Accountant is a key operational member of the Finance team, responsible for owning day-to-day billing and accounts receivable activities while also serving as a backup and support resource across accounts payable, procurement, and general ledger operations.

This role sits at the intersection of accounting operations, customer communication, and financial systems. The Associate Staff Accountant ensures timely and accurate invoicing, collections, and customer support, while also contributing to month-end close, reconciliations, and process automation initiatives. You will work closely with the Associate Accounting Manager, Controller, and internal account managers to maintain accurate financial records and support scalable finance operations.

What You Will Do

Primary Responsibilities: Billing & Accounts Receivable

  • Customer Billing Ownership: Prepare, review, and issue accurate customer invoices in accordance with contracts, pricing schedules, and billing timelines.
  • Collections Management: Monitor accounts receivable aging, proactively follow up on overdue invoices, and manage customer communications to drive timely payment.
  • Cash Application: Apply customer payments accurately and promptly; research and resolve unapplied cash, short payments, and discrepancies.
  • Billing Disputes & Resolution: Partner with customers and internal account managers to investigate and resolve billing questions, disputes, and adjustments.
  • Customer Support: Serve as a primary finance contact for billing and payment inquiries, delivering clear, professional, and timely responses.

Reporting, Analysis & Cross-Functional Support

  • AR & Billing Reporting: Prepare AR aging reports, collections summaries, billing metrics, and customer-level analysis for Finance leadership.
  • Trend & Issue Identification: Identify recurring billing or collections issues and recommend process improvements.
  • Internal Collaboration: Support Customer Success and Account Management teams with invoice status, payment history, and customer financial insights.
  • Ad-Hoc Analysis: Assist with financial analysis and special projects related to revenue, AR, or operational accounting.

Secondary Responsibilities: AP, Procurement & GL (Backup Coverage)

  • Accounts Payable Support: Serve as backup for the full-cycle AP process, including invoice review, coding, approvals, and payment execution using tools such as Ramp.
  • Procurement & Spend Compliance: Ensure spend is appropriately authorized, documented, and coded to the correct GL accounts, departments, and locations.
  • Expense Management: Support travel and expense processing, including receipt matching and policy enforcement.
  • Vendor Relations (Backup): Assist with vendor inquiries and resolution of payment or billing issues as needed.

General Ledger & Month-End Close Support

  • Journal Entries: Prepare and post routine journal entries, accruals, and adjustments under supervision to support accurate financial reporting.
  • Reconciliations: Perform monthly reconciliations of bank and balance sheet accounts, investigating and resolving variances.
  • Audit & Documentation: Maintain organized support schedules and documentation for management review and external audits.
  • System Integrity: Monitor accounting system data flows to ensure automated postings align with accounting principles and internal controls.
  • Process Automation: Support ongoing efforts to improve efficiency and reduce manual work using modern accounting and fintech tools (e.g., Rillet, Ramp).

What We Are Looking For

  • Accounting Foundation: Solid understanding of basic accounting principles; familiarity with GAAP preferred.
  • AR & Billing Experience: Prior experience in billing, accounts receivable, collections, or customer-facing finance roles.
  • Customer Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal English skills with the ability to communicate professionally with external customers.
  • Technical Proficiency: Experience with modern accounting, billing, or expense management systems (e.g., Rillet, Ramp, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Zuora, Stripe, or similar).
  • Excel Skills: Proficient in Excel, including formulas, lookups, and pivot tables.
  • Detail-Oriented & Organized: High attention to accuracy, deadlines, and follow-through in a process-driven environment.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable supporting multiple accounting functions and serving as backup when priorities shift.
  • Experience Level: 4+ years of relevant accounting, billing, or AR experience; experience supporting US-based companies is a plus.

We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

  • AR & Billing Reporting: Prepare AR aging reports, collections summaries, billing metrics, and customer-level analysis for Finance leadership.
  • Trend & Issue Identification: Identify recurring billing or collections issues and recommend process improvements.
  • Internal Collaboration: Support Customer Success and Account Management teams with invoice status, payment history, and customer financial insights.
  • Ad-Hoc Analysis: Assist with financial analysis and special projects related to revenue, AR, or operational accounting.

Secondary Responsibilities: AP, Procurement & GL (Backup Coverage)

  • Accounts Payable Support: Serve as backup for the full-cycle AP process, including invoice review, coding, approvals, and payment execution using tools such as Ramp.
  • Procurement & Spend Compliance: Ensure spend is appropriately authorized, documented, and coded to the correct GL accounts, departments, and locations.
  • Expense Management: Support travel and expense processing, including receipt matching and policy enforcement.
  • Vendor Relations (Backup): Assist with vendor inquiries and resolution of payment or billing issues as needed.

General Ledger & Month-End Close Support

  • Journal Entries: Prepare and post routine journal entries, accruals, and adjustments under supervision to support accurate financial reporting.
  • Reconciliations: Perform monthly reconciliations of bank and balance sheet accounts, investigating and resolving variances.
  • Audit & Documentation: Maintain organized support schedules and documentation for management review and external audits.
  • System Integrity: Monitor accounting system data flows to ensure automated postings align with accounting principles and internal controls.
  • Process Automation: Support ongoing efforts to improve efficiency and reduce manual work using modern accounting and fintech tools (e.g., Rillet, Ramp).

What We Are Looking For

  • Accounting Foundation: Solid understanding of basic accounting principles; familiarity with GAAP preferred.
  • AR & Billing Experience: Prior experience in billing, accounts receivable, collections, or customer-facing finance roles.
  • Customer Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal English skills with the ability to communicate professionally with external customers.
  • Technical Proficiency: Experience with modern accounting, billing, or expense management systems (e.g., Rillet, Ramp, NetSuite, QuickBooks, Zuora, Stripe, or similar).
  • Excel Skills: Proficient in Excel, including formulas, lookups, and pivot tables.
  • Detail-Oriented & Organized: High attention to accuracy, deadlines, and follow-through in a process-driven environment.
  • Adaptability: Comfortable supporting multiple accounting functions and serving as backup when priorities shift.
  • Experience Level: 4+ years of relevant accounting, billing, or AR experience; experience supporting US-based companies is a plus.

We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Diretor de Experiência do Cliente no Varejo

Somos uma startup de IA criada para o varejo - e estamos procurando profissionais de varejo.

A STOREE.AI é uma startup em crescimento que leva IA para lojas físicas de forma prática e pé no chão.

Ajudamos organizações de varejo a conduzirem melhor as operações do dia a dia - comunicação, tarefas, prioridades, acompanhamentos e KPIs - usando uma IA que funciona como um ótimo gestor.

Você não precisa ter background técnico.

Sem experiência com software. Sem conhecimento em IA.

Nós construímos a tecnologia.

Você traz a experiência de varejo.

Essa é a parceria.

A STOREE.AI é usada diariamente por mais de 100 redes de lojas no mundo.

  • Transformar prioridades em tarefas executáveis

Nossa plataforma é poderosa, mas varejo não é “tamanho único”.

O que importa para uma rede de moda não é o mesmo que importa para um supermercado.

O que um líder de VM procura é diferente do que HR/RH ou Operações procuram.

Por isso, não estamos buscando vendedores tradicionais.

Estamos buscando profissionais seniores de varejo que consigam:

  • Entender as necessidades reais de uma organização de varejo
  • Ajudar a moldar o “gestor de IA” certo para cada rede
  • Falar a linguagem do varejo, não buzzwords
  • Conduzir conversas com credibilidade e profundidade

Isso é desenvolvimento de negócios baseado em entendimento, não em “pitch”.

O que você vai fazer na prática:

  • Construir relacionamentos com organizações de varejo relevantes
  • Iniciar conversas usando nossas ferramentas de IA (treinamento completo incluído)
  • Mostrar como a STOREE.AI se encaixa na realidade específica deles
  • Conduzir o processo ou passar para nosso time central quando necessário
  • Influenciar a direção do produto - você será nosso olhar de varejo dentro da empresa

Você não vai “vender software”.

Você vai conectar experiência com soluções reais.

Para quem é:

Líderes seniores de varejo, incluindo:

  • Gerentes de loja, distrito e regional
  • Líderes de HQ em operações, RH, treinamento, VM, CX ou excelência no varejo
  • Qualquer pessoa que já liderou equipes de varejo e quer dar o próximo passo

  • Remuneração por comissão, com possibilidade de efetivação full-time
  • Chance de entrar antes de uma grande escala global
  • Tecnologia real, já funcionando no campo

  • Pacote Office básico (Outlook, Excel, Word);

title: Delivery Lead
description:
Required Skills & Experience

5+ years of experience in delivery lead role

Experience delivering data and analytics products in a production environment

Working knowledge of:

• ETL processes and data pipelines

• BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau

Strong communication skills with the ability to translate between business, product, and engineering teams

Demonstrated ability to identify issues early and escalate effectively

Nice to Have Skills & Experience

Experience supporting logistics, transportation, or pricing analytics initiatives

Background working with Azure-based data ecosystems

Familiarity with database backends and data modeling concepts

Experience operating in complex, cross-functional enterprise environments

Job Description

Insight Global is looking to add a Delivery Lead to their client’s Data & Analytics organization. This person will own the end-to-end delivery of logistics and transportation initiatives, ensuring solutions are delivered on time with high quality and operational reliability. They will support and enhance Transportation Management Systems (TMS) and related logistics data products, ensuring business users have accurate, timely data to drive insights into transportation performance, pricing, and KPIs, etc. They will act as a key liaison between business, product, and engineering teams and will be responsible for translating business needs into clear, actionable requirements, identifying gaps in definition, and partnering with Product Managers to clarify scope before work reaches engineering. They will work closely with engineers to provide business context, facilitate effective technical discussions, and proactively identify and escalate risks related to delivery quality and timelines. This role also leads or supports incident management for data, analytics, and logistics systems by triaging issues, determining actionability, collaborating with engineering on resolution, and ensuring incidents are documented and addressed to prevent recurrence. They will support sprint planning, backlog refinement, delivery tracking, and continuous improvement across delivery processes.

• BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau

Strong communication skills with the ability to translate between business, product, and engineering teams

Demonstrated ability to identify issues early and escalate effectively

Nice to Have Skills & Experience

Experience supporting logistics, transportation, or pricing analytics initiatives

Background working with Azure-based data ecosystems

Familiarity with database backends and data modeling concepts

Experience operating in complex, cross-functional enterprise environments

Job Description

Insight Global is looking to add a Delivery Lead to their client’s Data & Analytics organization. This person will own the end-to-end delivery of logistics and transportation initiatives, ensuring solutions are delivered on time with high quality and operational reliability. They will support and enhance Transportation Management Systems (TMS) and related logistics data products, ensuring business users have accurate, timely data to drive insights into transportation performance, pricing, and KPIs, etc. They will act as a key liaison between business, product, and engineering teams and will be responsible for translating business needs into clear, actionable requirements, identifying gaps in definition, and partnering with Product Managers to clarify scope before work reaches engineering. They will work closely with engineers to provide business context, facilitate effective technical discussions, and proactively identify and escalate risks related to delivery quality and timelines. This role also leads or supports incident management for data, analytics, and logistics systems by triaging issues, determining actionability, collaborating with engineering on resolution, and ensuring incidents are documented and addressed to prevent recurrence. They will support sprint planning, backlog refinement, delivery tracking, and continuous improvement across delivery processes.

Atuar com cópias de clientes e sistemas (homogêneas e heterogêneas).

Monitorar performance do ambiente (SM50, ST22, ST03, DBACOCKPIT, etc.).

title: SR. Desenvolvimento Mainframe
description:
Aqui na ília nossas vagas estão sempre abertas para todas as pessoas e não se restringem quanto a gênero, etnia, orientação sexual, fatores sociais, condições físicas ou intelectuais (PCD) etc. Incentivamos a candidatura de integrantes de todos os grupos minoritários!

Sobre a ília

Somos especialistas em tecnologia, dados e design, impulsionando a transformação digital de grandes players do mercado há mais de 10 anos, nos setores financeiro, seguros e mobilidade. Com mais de 450 profissionais, estamos presentes no Brasil e Europa, atendendo aos mercados da América Latina, Europa e América do Norte, desenvolvendo produtos digitais de alta qualidade e com foco em resultados de negócios. Somos uma equipe inovadora, criativa e apaixonada por tecnologia.

Certificada pelo 7º ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

#Vempraília

Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento em Alta Plataforma / Mainframe
  • Experiência comprovada em Cobol
  • Experiência em Cobol CICS para aplicações transacionais online
  • Experiência em Natural/Adabas
  • Experiência em JCL para processamento batch
  • Experiência Com DB2
  • Experiência em Sort (DFSORT/SYNCSORT)
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento e manutenção de processos batch e online
  • Conhecimento de VSAM
  • Experiência em análise e tratamento de erros em ambientes produtivos
  • Experiência com ambiente z/OS
  • Conhecimento em integração entre sistemas mainframe e plataformas distribuídas (via arquivos, mensageria ou APIs)
  • Experiência em análise de impacto, correção de incidentes e sustentação de sistemas críticos
  • Experiência em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban)
  • Capacidade de leitura, entendimento e evolução de sistemas legados complexos

Diferenciais

  • Conhecimento em modernização de sistemas legados (mainframe para baixa plataforma/cloud)
  • Experiência em ambientes financeiros ou bancários
  • Conhecimento de arquiteturas híbridas (mainframe + cloud)
  • Vivência em SRE, observabilidade ou monitoração de sistemas críticos
  • Capacidade de atuar como referência técnica e apoiar desenvolvedores mais juniores

Benefícios e Incentivos

Nossa contratação é CLT- 40h semanais com jornada flexível, sendo executada de forma remota. Os benefícios da ília são pensados para proporcionar uma experiência AWESOME para cada ílian, abaixo você encontra os benefícios de forma resumida. #vempraília

Para Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico SulAmérica extensivo a dependentes;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição em cartão flexível Caju benefícios
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Auxílio Home-Office em cartão flexível Caju benefícios;
  • Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Sesc – extensivo a dependentes, com acesso aos serviços em todo o Brasil;
  • TotalPass.

Para o seu Desenvolvimento:

  • ília University: Universidade Corporativa com mais de 20 mil cursos disponíveis para desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional;
  • Language Academy: Escola de idiomas para ílians;
  • í-talks e Chapter: Momentos e cerimônias em que o time compartilha práticas, estudos, projetos e ideias. Nas chapters ainda se reúnem pessoas com skills similares para compartilhamento de ideias, práticas e experiências;

Gostamos de ir além no cuidado com as nossas pessoas, então dispomos também de alguns benefícios não convencionais:

  • Plano de Saúde PET - Guapeco
  • Onhappy – benefício de viagem a lazer, com liberdade para você viajar com quem quiser.
  • BYOD - Alugamos o seu notebook pessoal te pagando um valor mensal para que você o use, mas disponibilizamos também máquinas de trabalho para ílians. Você quem decide!
  • Seu Niver, seu bolo!
  • Seu Networking Vale Prêmio - Programa de premiação a indicação de novos funcionários.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) FrontEnd Pleno | Plataforma
description:
A Plataforma desenvolve produtos que sustentam experiências digitais essenciais dentro do ecossistema Sankhya, com foco em reutilização, escala e qualidade.

A missão desta posição é construir interfaces frontend modernas e reutilizáveis , contribuindo para a evolução técnica do time e para uma experiência consistente e escalável.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver interfaces frontend com foco em reutilização
  • Atuar com arquitetura de Micro Front-End
  • Criar e customizar componentes em Design System
  • Trabalhar com Web Components
  • Integrar interfaces com serviços backend
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares
  • Propor melhorias técnicas e de usabilidade
  • Utilizar ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial no dia a dia de engenharia para apoio em diagnóstico de problemas, revisão de código, documentação técnica e aceleração de entregas, garantindo uso responsável e seguro das informações.


Requisitos

  • Experiência com React
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de Micro Front-End

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
About Us

Marketing Ninjas is a cutting-edge marketing agency specializing in helping restoration companies gain more referral partners and secure exclusive leads. As a faith-driven and ninja-themed company, we operate with the highest standards, integrity, and a commitment to excellence. Our mission is to empower our clients with the tools and strategies they need to grow their businesses successfully.


Job Overview

We’re looking for a Client Success Manager (CSM) who is passionate about building relationships, ensuring client satisfaction, and driving results. The CSM will serve as the primary point of contact for our clients, ensuring they see maximum value from our services and continue to grow with us. This role requires exceptional communication skills, a strong command of English with minimal accent , and a proactive approach to client engagement.


Key Responsibilities

  • Client Onboarding & Relationship Management: Guide new clients through the onboarding process, ensuring a smooth and positive experience.
  • Ongoing Support & Strategy: Regularly check in with clients to review performance, provide strategic insights, and optimize their marketing campaigns.
  • Retention & Growth: Identify opportunities for upselling or cross-selling additional services to help clients scale their businesses.
  • Issue Resolution: Address client concerns promptly and professionally, working with internal teams to resolve any challenges.
  • Training & Education: Educate clients on best practices for using our Marketing Ninjas Lead Engine , powered by GoHighLevel .
  • Performance Monitoring: Track client success metrics and proactively reach out to offer guidance and improvements.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with our sales, marketing, and fulfillment teams using Slack, ClickUp, and GoHighLevel to ensure a seamless client experience.


What We’re Looking For

  • Experience: 2+ years in a client success, account management, or customer service role (preferably in digital marketing, SaaS, or home services industries).
  • Communication Skills:Fluent English speaker with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Minimal accent for clear and effective communication with U.S.-based clients.
  • Tech-Savvy: Experience using GoHighLevel, Slack, and ClickUp (or similar CRM and project management tools).
  • Comfortable with marketing automation and CRM tools.
  • Problem-Solving: Ability to think critically and proactively address client concerns.
  • Results-Driven: Passionate about helping clients succeed and achieving high retention rates.
  • Organized & Detail-Oriented: Ability to manage multiple clients and tasks efficiently.
  • Faith & Integrity: A commitment to conducting business with the highest ethical standards.


Why Join Marketing Ninjas?

  • Work with a mission-driven team that operates with integrity and excellence.
  • Remote work flexibility – work from anywhere!
  • Opportunities for growth in a fast-paced, ninja-themed marketing agency.
  • Competitive salary + performance-based incentives.
  • Supportive team environment with a strong focus on faith, values, and client success.


Ready to Join the Ninja Squad?

If you’re passionate about helping businesses grow , building strong client relationships , and delivering exceptional service , we’d love to hear from you! Apply today and become part of the Marketing Ninjas team.


To move forward with your application, please complete this short form:

Apply here:

title: Engenheiro de Software Backend IA
description:
Estamos em busca de uma pessoa desenvolvedora com foco em soluções de IA Generativa , que seja apaixonada por arquiteturas escaláveis, automações e inteligência conversacional. Buscamos alguém com domínio de Python e experiência prática com soluções modernas de IA aplicadas ao mercado real — especialmente com agentes autônomos, RAG e integrações em nuvem.

Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e manter backends orientados a modelos de linguagem , utilizando LangChain , RAG e arquiteturas baseadas em agentes (multi-agent systems);
  • Construir e orquestrar fluxos com filas (SQS) para garantir escalabilidade e processamento assíncrono;
  • Implementar soluções de IA generativa aplicadas a assistentes virtuais e automações;
  • Realizar integrações com serviços AWS (Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, SQS, etc.);
  • Monitorar o desempenho de agentes e sistemas de IA em produção, ajustando quando necessário;
  • Colaborar com times de produto, dados e engenharia para evoluir continuamente a arquitetura.

Qualificações obrigatórias:

  • Domínio de Python ;
  • Experiência prática com LangChain e/ou frameworks similares de orquestração de LLMs;
  • Conhecimento sobre RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) e integração com vetores;
  • Experiência com AWS , especialmente SQS , Lambda, DynamoDB e S3;
  • Vivência em arquiteturas com agentes autônomos (multi-agents) ;
  • Familiaridade com consumo de APIs de LLMs (como OpenAI);

title: Desenvolvedor BackEnd Sênior - JavaScript/Node + AWS (com atuação em arquitetura e refinamento de requisitos)
description:
Sobre a InBot:

Somos uma empresa especializada em Inteligência Artificial Conversacional. Desenvolvemos assistentes virtuais inteligentes que integram PLN (Processamento de Linguagem Natural), busca semântica e IA generativa, oferecendo experiências únicas para usuários e resultados práticos para nossos clientes.

Na InBot, você vai trabalhar com projetos que envolvem desde personagens digitais (como Mia, Ricardo, Fernando) até soluções robustas para grandes empresas e governos, usando tecnologia de ponta para transformar a comunicação entre pessoas e organizações.

Mais sobre nós:

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Arquitetura e Refinamento Técnico (Discovery → Delivery): Atuar junto às áreas de negócio e ao time técnico no levantamento, análise e refinamento de requisitos, traduzindo necessidades em especificações técnicas claras (user stories, critérios de aceite, regras de negócio, fluxos e integrações) e apoiando a definição da melhor arquitetura para entrega.

Gestão Técnica do Backlog: Apoiar a organização e priorização técnica das demandas, garantindo que as atividades estejam bem detalhadas, quebradas em entregas incrementais e com dependências mapeadas, reduzindo retrabalho e aumentando previsibilidade.

Definição de Solução e Padrões: Propor e documentar padrões técnicos, decisões de arquitetura (ADRs), contratos de API e boas práticas (observabilidade, versionamento, consistência de integrações, idempotência, retries, rate limit, etc.), garantindo escalabilidade e manutenibilidade.

Colaboração e Alinhamento Contínuo: Participar ativamente de cerimônias ágeis (refinamento, planning, review), contribuindo para clareza técnica, estimativas realistas e alinhamento entre produto, operações e desenvolvimento.

Qualidade e Segurança no Ciclo de Desenvolvimento: Reforçar práticas de code review, testes automatizados, análise estática e segurança (OWASP, gestão de segredos, IAM least privilege), garantindo qualidade do código e confiabilidade das entregas.

Uso de IA Generativa com Governança: Utilizar IA generativa para potencializar produtividade (análise de logs, geração/validação de testes, rascunho de documentação, scaffolding de código e refatorações assistidas), mantendo rigor em revisão humana, versionamento, padrões internos e práticas de segurança.

Mentoria e Multiplicação Técnica: Apoiar o desenvolvimento do time, com mentorias, revisão de PRs, suporte em decisões de design e disseminação de boas práticas para elevar o nível técnico do squad.

Desenvolvimento em Nuvem: Atuar em ambientes AWS (EC2, EKS, ECR, ACM, RDS), garantindo performance, escalabilidade e segurança.

Conteinerização e Orquestração: Implementar e gerenciar containers com Docker e Kubernetes (administração, criação de pods, serviços, ingress, etc.).

Integrações de Sistemas: Desenvolver integrações entre o assistente virtual e os sistemas dos clientes utilizando APIs REST e JSON, além de OpenAPI/Swagger.

Desenvolvimento Backend: Trabalhar principalmente com JavaScript, Node.js, Promises, HTML5, CSS e TypeScript para criar funcionalidades robustas e assíncronas de forma eficiente.

Autenticação e Segurança: Implementar autenticação com OIDC (OpenID Connect), SAML e aplicar práticas de desenvolvimento seguro.

Criação e Manutenção de APIs: Desenvolver APIs internas e externas com documentação clara e padronizada.

Gestão de Bancos de Dados: Criar, administrar e otimizar bancos relacionais e não relacionais (SQL, MongoDB, RDS na AWS).

Ambiente Linux: Gerenciar e configurar servidores Linux, utilizando Shell Script para automação.

Controle de Versões: Utilizar Git para versionamento de código, integração contínua e práticas de CI/CD.

Desenvolvimento de Relatórios: Criar queries e relatórios para produtos e serviços.

Boas Práticas: Aplicar Promises, testes automatizados, documentação de código e metodologias ágeis para garantir escalabilidade e qualidade.

Diferenciais:

Experiência com arquitetura orientada a eventos (filas, mensageria, processamento assíncrono) e padrões de resiliência.

Familiaridade com IA aplicada ao ciclo de desenvolvimento (ex.: geração de testes, revisão assistida, documentação automatizada) com governança e segurança.

Conhecimento em microserviços e arquitetura serverless.

Experiência com DevOps e ferramentas de CI/CD.

Familiaridade com IA Generativa para otimização de processos e experiência do usuário.

Conhecimento em arquitetura de sistemas (redes, firewalls, DNS, roteamento, modelagem de dados).

Experiência com Java ou Scala.

Desenvolvimento Full Stack: Atuar também em camadas de front-end sempre que necessário, garantindo a integração de ponta a ponta.

Requisitos e qualificações

Formação Acadêmica: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência: Mínimo 5 anos comprovados em desenvolvimento, essencialmente com JavaScript e Node.js.

Conhecimentos Técnicos Imprescindíveis:

AWS (EC2, EKS/Kubernetes, ECR, ACM, RDS)

APIs REST e JSON

Git (controle de código e versionamento)

Linux (administração e Shell)

Promises e programação assíncrona em JavaScript

Práticas de desenvolvimento seguro e testes automatizados

Soft Skills e Competências Comportamentais:

Tradução Negócio ↔ Técnica: Capacidade de entender rapidamente o contexto do cliente e transformar necessidades em soluções técnicas claras, alinhadas com prazos, riscos e impactos.

Senso de Dono e Pragmatismo: Foco em entregar valor com qualidade, escolhendo soluções sustentáveis e evitando complexidade desnecessária.

Organização e Comunicação Técnica: Saber conduzir refinamentos, registrar decisões e manter o time alinhado, garantindo transparência e clareza sobre escopo, riscos e dependências.

Trabalho em Equipe: Colaborar com times multidisciplinares, garantindo alinhamento técnico e de negócio.

Organização e Gestão de Prioridades: Capacidade de lidar com múltiplos projetos simultaneamente e cumprir prazos.

Comunicação: Clareza e objetividade ao se comunicar com clientes e equipe interna.

Senso de Lógica e Criatividade: Resolver problemas de forma analítica, criando soluções robustas e escaláveis.

Informações adicionais

Contrato PJ + cartão Flash.

Regime híbrido: presencial até 3x por semana no escritório (próximo à Av. Paulista).

Projetos desafiadores e inovadores, com tecnologia de ponta em IA conversacional.

  • Ambiente colaborativo, que valoriza autonomia, criatividade e foco em resultado.

title: Video Lead
description:
Impact3 - Video Lead

Join Impact3 – Help Us Change the Game in Crypto

Location: 100% Remote


How to Apply

  • Please submit a 2–3 minute Loom video highlighting your experience with video editing, including the tools you use, how you leverage AI, and your overall creative process. Be sure to attach your portfolio as well.


About Impact3

Impact3 is a growth marketing agency of crypto-native marketers dedicated to building trusted brands in the trustless technology space - aka crypto.

We specialize in social media management, public relations, paid advertising, visual production, strategy, go-to-market campaigns and more.


The Role

We don’t want just a \"Video Editor.\" We want a Video Architect. You should be someone who looks at a manual 20-hour editing task and finds a way to do it in 4 hours at a higher quality using your custom AI tech stack.

As the Video Lead at Impact3, you are the architect of our visual narrative. You don’t just \"edit video\", you build the engine that produces high-end, viral-ready content at the speed of the internet. You will lead a team of creators to transform complex crypto concepts into hyper-realistic, professional video assets.

This is a leadership role, but it is also hands-on. You must be comfortable leading a team while actively working inside Premiere Pro and After Effects yourself.

Your mission is to bridge the gap between \"standard social video\" and \"cinematic AI production,\" ensuring Impact3 remains the most innovative agency in the Web3 space.


  • Hyper-Realistic Storyboarding: Lead the pre-production process by using AI to generate high-fidelity, professional-grade storyboards that look like final frames. You will set the visual \"North Star\" for every project before a single second of video is rendered.
  • Production Leadership (Hands-On): Manage and mentor a team of video editors, ensuring all outputs meet \"Senior\" quality standards while maintaining an AI-first workflow. You must be capable of stepping in, solving technical challenges directly, and setting the creative and technical bar through execution.
  • End-to-End AI Integration: Own the process of incorporating generative AI (Video-to-Video, Text-to-Video, AI Voiceover, and Generative Audio) into the traditional post-production pipeline.
  • Process Architecture: Document and refine the \"Impact3 Video Playbook\"—creating scalable workflows that allow the team to pivot from TikTok/Reels to high-end brand films instantly.
  • Quality Control: Act as the final gatekeeper for visual polish, advanced motion graphics, color grading, and \"the vibe,\" ensuring everything is culturally relevant to the crypto audience.


Key Skills and Qualifications

  • Proficient English Level: You must be able to communicate complex creative visions and lead meetings in English fluently. This is non-negotiable.
  • Vast AI Knowledge: You must demonstrate a documented history of using AI tools (e.g., Runway, Pika, Sora, Kling, Midjourney, ElevenLabs) to solve production bottlenecks and elevate visual quality.
  • Capacity to Lead: You have experience managing creative teams, giving actionable feedback, setting standards, and taking ownership of deadlines.
  • Storyboarding Mastery: Ability to create professional, hyper-realistic boards that accurately represent lighting, composition, and movement.
  • Adobe Proficiency (Premiere + After Effects): You must be highly proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro and advanced in After Effects. After Effects proficiency is mandatory for professional-grade motion graphics, compositing, and AI-integrated post-production workflows.
  • Hands-On Technical Strength: You are not just a manager—you are capable of executing complex edits, building motion systems, and solving production challenges directly.
  • (Nice to have) Crypto-Native Fluency: Understanding \"Crypto Twitter\" culture, memes, and the visual language of Web3 is a major plus but not a dealbreaker if you are a fast learner.


How Our Team Works (Our Ethos)

  • We’re in this together: no silos, no egos; we support each other.
  • Take ownership: be accountable, act like an owner, go the extra mile.
  • Get shit done: move fast, focus on execution, learn by doing.
  • Simplify & systemize: build processes, document workflows, work smarter.
  • Lead by example: learn first, then teach and raise the bar.
  • Speak up: over-communicate, ask for help, share ideas openly.
  • Get obsessed: live the space, bring curiosity, chase excellence.


What We Offer:

  • A dynamic and challenging role in a rapidly evolving industry.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and leadership development.
  • A collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Remote work: our team spans Canada, USA, Mexico, Spain, Italy, Bulgaria, Albania, Macedonia, Romania, India, Portugal, Brazil, Argentina and more.
  • Annual retreat to build relationships and plan for growth.
  • Competitive compensation based on skills and experience.

title: SAP Basis Consultant
description:
Analista PL / Consultor SAP Basis



Responsabilidades:


1. Fornecer suporte técnico avançado, aderindo aos padrões de qualidade e requisitos regulamentares, garantindo a conformidade com as políticas da empresa nos ambientes SAP Basis e SAP HANA DB.

2. Resolver incidentes complexos escalados por analistas, realizando análises de causa raiz completas e implementando soluções eficazes para resolver problemas técnicos e de segurança.

3. Facilitar a transferência de conhecimento, atualizando e gerenciando a base de conhecimento, treinando novos membros da equipe e orientando analistas para aprimorar as capacidades da equipe.

4. Gerenciar e resolver chamados complexos dentro dos SLAs acordados, colaborando com equipes de suporte multifuncionais para manter a eficiência operacional e garantir uma postura de segurança robusta.

5. Aprimorar a experiência do cliente, alcançando altas taxas de resolução no primeiro contato, minimizando resoluções rejeitadas e reaberturas de casos, enquanto mitiga proativamente as ameaças à segurança.


Requisitos:

  • Inglês avançado. - boa comunicação, participação em chamadas, etc. (OBRIGATÓRIO)
  • Sólido conhecimento do pacote de soluções SAP e arquitetura técnica, com capacidade de traduzir desafios de negócios.
  • 4. Fortes habilidades de consultoria e gestão de stakeholders – habilidades demonstráveis de apresentação, consultoria voltada para o cliente e influência até o nível executivo (C-suite). Todos os candidatos devem ser assertivos e articulados, com capacidade de desenvolver e manter relacionamentos com clientes de alto nível.
  • 5. Compreensão da estratégia de produto da SAP, incluindo o posicionamento do S/4HANA e ferramentas de habilitação e tecnologias complementares, especialmente a integração com outros aplicativos.
  • 6. Bom conhecimento das ofertas de nuvem pública GCP, AWS e Azure e arquitetura de soluções.

title: Technical Lead
description:
Technical Lead

We are looking for a Technical Lead to come and work in the Environments work stream. The Environments work stream is focused on building and deploying environments that are used within Global Fabric. These environments are E2E across multiple domains including Public Cloud, On-Prem Cloud and Telecommunications equipment.

  • Lead the design, engineering and integration of environments (across compute, storage, network and software layers)
  • Define and maintain environment blueprints, infrastructure configurations and automation pipelines
  • Ensure that environments are fit for purpose - performant, stable, secure and compliant (Architecturally and Operationally)
  • Implement and drive environment automation to get us closer to self-service
  • Standardise environment deployment to remove manual processes
  • Lead across a variety of teams to align and drive in the right direction

Skills and Experience:

  • Experience with Prometheus, OpenSearch/Elastic and Grafana
  • Infrastructure engineering and automation across multiple domains
  • Strong understanding of Kubernetes.
  • Experience with large distributed systems
  • Strong Python to drive automation and troubleshoot issues as and when they occur
  • Experience with Telecoms, Netbox and Itential is a bonus

title: AutoDesk Software Developer - INTL
description:
Location: INTL - Brazil, Mexico, Chile, Costa Rica

Term: Contract. 12-months.

Type: Remote

Rate: Hourly

Job Description

Insight Global is looking for an Intermediate Software Developer to join a large construction company in a remote 12-month contract with possibility of extension based in Edmonton Alberta but working out of Latin America. This role is focused on designing, building, maintaining, and evolving a portfolio of 50+ custom software tools that support Virtual Design & Construction (VDC) and Building Information Modeling (BIM) workflows across the organization.

The Intermediate Software Developer will work hands-on with existing codebases to enhance, refactor, modernize, or retire tools based on usage, stability, and business value. This individual will collaborate closely with internal developers, VDC and BIM specialists, ICT partners, and external vendors to deliver high quality, maintainable solutions that remain aligned with the latest Autodesk platforms and APIs, providing real-world impact across multiple districts.

Required Skills & Experience

• Strong recent experience developing software for Autodesk products, including Revit and Navisworks

• Hands-on development experience with .NET and C#, including deep experience using the Revit API and Navisworks API

• Solid understanding of software architecture, versioning, and long-term maintainability

• Experience working with modern development and deployment tools, such as Azure DevOps and cloud-based CI/CD pipelines

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field

Nice to Have Skills & Experience

•Experience working with Power BI or other data-driven tooling

•Familiarity with Autodesk Forge / APS and external API integrations

•Background developing or supporting custom software within construction, engineering, or AEC environments

title: Senior Android Engineer - Remote - Talent Pool
description:
About the Role

We’re building a talent pool for Senior Android Engineers . This pipeline role is for engineers with strong experience, skilled in building high-performance, scalable mobile systems , and following best practices for architecture, performance, and maintainability.

What You’ll Do

- Build and maintain high-performance, scalable Android applications.

- Design app architecture, implement best practices for performance, memory optimization, and offline workflows.

- Integrate Android platform features, including push notifications, secure storage, sensors, and background services.

- Collaborate with backend, product, and QA teams to deliver high-quality mobile solutions.

- Contribute to technical decisions, code reviews, and continuous improvement of Android development practices.

What We’re Looking For

- 7+ years of professional Android development experience.

- Deep expertise in Kotlin and modern Android development practices.

- Proven ability to deliver high-quality code within project timelines.

- Experience with Jetpack libraries (Compose, Navigation, Room, LiveData, WorkManager).

- Familiarity with testing frameworks for Android (Espresso, JUnit, UI Automator).

- Knowledge of app distribution, CI/CD pipelines, and release processes for Google Play.

Nice To Have

- Experience with cross-platform mobile development (React Native, Flutter) or multi-module Android projects.

- Hands-on experience with GraphQL, REST APIs, or secure API integrations.

Why Join Kake?

Kake is a remote-first company with a global community — fully believing that it’s not where your table is, but what you bring to the table that matters. We provide top-tier engineering teams to support some of the world’s most innovative companies, and we’ve built a culture where great people stay, grow, and thrive. We’re proud to be more than just a stop along the way in your career — we’re the destination.

The icing on the Kake:

Competitive Pay in USD – Work globally, get paid globally.

Fully Remote – Simply put, we trust you.

Better Me Fund – We invest in your personal growth and passions.

❤️ Compassion is Badass – Join a community that invests in social good.

title: Account Executive
description:
Join us to witness the rapid growth of Keeta´s global food delivery business, experiencing firsthand the industry transformation and growth miracles. You will collaborate with a world-class, diverse team, fostering innovative thinking and expanding your international perspective while deepening your expertise. This is not just a job—it's an unparalleled opportunity to achieve personal growth, realize your self-worth, and drive global business innovation


Responsibilities

  • Identify and secure partnerships with restaurants willing to collaborate with Meituan Keeta through efficient scheduling and in-person visits, and negotiate cooperation agreements.
  • Assist partner restaurants in setting up online delivery stores on the platform and provide training for managing their online business operations.
  • Offer professional solutions for merchants' takeout business operations, assist merchants in increasing their turnover, and achieve win-win cooperation with Keeta.
  • Conduct regular follow-ups with partner restaurants to maintain customer relationships and coordinate with various departments to resolve daily inquiries.


Qualifications


  • Proficiency in English and Portuguese as working languages; basic English reading and writing skills required, along with proficiency in using office software.
  • Strong business negotiation and market development skills, with the ability to understand customer needs and drive business partnerships.
  • Honesty, integrity, excellent communication, execution, and collaboration skills, as well as a strong sense of teamwork.
  • Entrepreneurial spirit, resilience, and a willingness to take on challenges with an altruistic mindset. Primarily involves on-site visits to negotiate and provide services directly to merchants.

title: Brand & Copy Strategist
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a Brand & Copy Strategist!


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


Purpose of This Position


As a Brand & Copy Strategist, you are responsible for writing and owning all copy for the clients within your squad, ensuring that every word reflects the brand’s voice, positioning, and intent.

You ensure that every piece of written content across websites, social media, email, and campaigns is on-brand, intentional, and delivered at a high standard. You bring together copywriting, brand awareness, practical content direction, strategy, and project management to ensure brands are represented clearly and consistently through words.


You act as the bridge between brand intent and execution, translating client goals and direction into clear, purposeful copy that is ready for internal review and client delivery.


Core Responsibility


Serve as the owner of brand representation through copy for your squad’s clients. Your accountability is defined by the following questions:

  • “Is this copy clear, on-brand, purposeful, and strong enough to confidently move forward?”
  • \"Is this project timeline possible with the resources we have for proper execution?”


Main Objectives


1. Content Execution & Copywriting

  • Write high-quality, purpose-driven copy for:
  • -Websites
  • -Social media captions and post copy
  • -Email campaigns
  • -Campaign and promotional assets
  • Design-related copy (headlines, CTAs, supporting text)
  • Act as the primary writer for all copy deliverables within your squad.
  • Ensure every piece of copy is written with intention, clarity, and audience awareness.
  • Perform copyediting on your own work to maintain consistency, grammatical excellence, and brand alignment, using tools and peers as needed.


2. Strategy & Project Management

  • Create social media strategies for your clients based on their goals and audiences
  • Keep track of client feedback and apply them to future work
  • Plan content in batches for the month, ensuring:
  • -Consistency in writing style
  • -Variety in content types
  • -A range of related, engaging topics


3. Social Media Copy & Content Direction

  • Develop and write social media copy that reflects the brand’s voice and messaging.
  • When appropriate, define content themes and messaging direction for social platforms.
  • When deeper strategy or clarity is required, collaborate with Special Teams to receive social content strategy support or plans.
  • Execute all social media copy in alignment with the strategy you create and flag any gaps or unclear direction early.


4. Creative Collaboration & Brand Consistency

  • Participate in brainstorming and ideation sessions to help define the content, messaging, and assets required for campaigns and initiatives.
  • Provide copy-led input on creative direction to ensure consistency of brand voice, messaging, and intent across all touchpoints.
  • Collaborate with designers, Marketing Coordinators, and Account Managers to align written and visual assets under a cohesive brand narrative.
  • Contribute perspective beyond copy when needed to maintain brand clarity and consistency.


5. Brand Advocacy

  • Act as the copy owner for each assigned brand, ensuring consistent voice, tone, and messaging across all written content.
  • Apply brand guidelines and positioning directly within copy execution.
  • Review copy deliverables to ensure they meet internal quality standards and accurately represent the brand’s intent.


Reporting Relationship

  • This role reports to the designated Account Manager of your squad.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


1. Brand Alignment & Copy Effectiveness

  • Ensure all copy deliverables are consistently aligned with the brand’s voice, tone, and messaging.
  • Maintain minimal client revisions related to brand alignment, tone, or clarity.
  • Contribute social content ideas and messaging angles when needed, ensuring alignment with the brand’s voice, positioning, and goals.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure brand consistency across copy and supporting assets.


2. Content Quality & Accuracy

  • Deliver copy that meets internal quality standards for clarity, structure, and purpose.
  • Maintain a low rate of client dissatisfaction related to copy quality or intent.


3. Project Delivery Timeliness

  • Deliver copy-related tasks within agreed timelines.
  • Collaborate with the squad to support smooth handoffs and on-time delivery of content assets.


Work Details

  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Senior React Native Engineer - Remote - Talent Pool
description:
About the Role

We’re building a talent pool for Senior React Native Engineers . This pipeline role is for engineers with strong experience, skilled in building high-performance, scalable mobile systems , and following best practices for architecture, performance, and maintainability.


What You’ll Do

- Build and maintain high-performance mobile apps using React Native and TypeScript.

- Design app architecture and manage state, navigation, and offline workflows.

- Integrate native iOS/Android modules and platform-specific features.

- Optimize performance and ensure maintainable, secure code.

- Collaborate with backend and product teams, contributing to technical decisions and releases.


What We’re Looking For

- 5+ years of React Native experience.

- Strong proficiency TypeScript and modern state management libraries (Redux, Zustand, Recoil, or equivalent ).

- Deep understanding of mobile app architecture : navigation, performance tuning, offline-first workflows, and background tasks.

- Experience with native iOS/Android modules (bridging, push notifications, secure storage).

- Proven ability to design and deliver apps that meet security and compliance standards (secure data storage, encryption, RBAC).

- Familiarity with CI/CD for mobile and release processes for App Store/Google Play.

- Excellent communication skills, able to collaborate across backend, DevOps, and product teams.

- Prior experience contributing to technical decision-making and architecture discussions.


Nice to Have

- Familiarity with GCP, Firebase, or mobile analytics frameworks.

- Experience building cross-platform libraries or contributing to open-source React Native projects.

- Hands-on work with GraphQL and secure API integrations.

- Understanding of mobile accessibility (WCAG) and performance monitoring tools.


Why Join Kake?

Kake is a remote-first company with a global community — fully believing that it’s not where your table is, but what you bring to the table that matters. We provide top-tier engineering teams to support some of the world’s most innovative companies, and we’ve built a culture where great people stay, grow, and thrive. We’re proud to be more than just a stop along the way in your career — we’re the destination.


The icing on the Kake:

Competitive Pay in USD – Work globally, get paid globally.

Fully Remote – Simply put, we trust you.

Better Me Fund – We invest in your personal growth and passions.

❤️ Compassion is Badass – Join a community that invests in social good.

title: Desenvolvedor/a SalesForce Pleno - Remoto
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.

Somos globais, somos GPTW.

♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:

Detalhes da oportunidade

Modelo de atuação: Remoto

Modelo de contratação: CLT + Benefícios

Atuar no time de CRM Systems (Salesforce) apoiando o desenvolvimento e evolução das soluções com foco em Service Cloud, contribuindo para a qualidade técnica das entregas e integração com os sistemas corporativos da companhia.

Responsabilidades

Desenvolvimento e manutenção de funcionalidades em Salesforce Service Cloud

Implementação de Apex

Desenvolvimento e manutenção de Flows

Implementação de Platform Events

Configuração e evolução de Omnichannel

Apoio na implementação de Bots

Participação nas cerimônias do squad em ambiente ágil (Scrum / Kanban)

Versionamento de código utilizando Git / GitHub

Apoio em processos de integração e deploy utilizando Jenkins

Interação com membros do time e áreas envolvidas para entendimento das demandas

Requisitos obrigatórios

Experiência com desenvolvimento Salesforce

Conhecimento em Apex

Experiência com Flows

Conhecimento em Platform Events

Conhecimento em Git / GitHub

Experiência em metodologias ágeis (Scrum ou Kanban)

Ingles - avançado (obrigatorio)

E temos o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Angular Developer - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.

What are we looking for?

  • 6+ years of professional experience as Angular Developer;
  • Experience with the latest versions of Angular;
  • Experience with TypeScript;
  • Fluency in English (mandatory);
  • Interest in working from Portugal (mandatory).

What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;

title: Consultor Funcional Sênior - Salesforce Field Service
description:
Consultor Funcional Sênior – Salesforce Field Service

Data de Início: Imediata

Tempo de Alocação: Indeterminado

Local de Trabalho: Rio de Janeiro/RJ (100% remoto com visitas eventuais e planejadas ao cliente)

Horário de Trabalho: 9h00 às 1800

*** Modelo remoto com eventuais viagens ao Rio de Janeiro (aproximadamente uma semana a cada 2–3 meses) ***

Área: Salesforce / Transformação Digital / Field Service Management

Visão Geral da Posição

Buscamos um(a) Consultor(a) Funcional Sênior com sólida experiência em Salesforce e forte atuação em projetos de Field Service. Este profissional será responsável por implementar, evoluir e sustentar soluções voltadas à gestão de operações de campo, com foco na otimização de agendas, eficiência operacional e aumento de produtividade das equipes técnicas.

A posição exige perfil consultivo e analítico, capaz de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções funcionais estruturadas no ecossistema Salesforce, atuando em ambientes corporativos complexos e de alta criticidade operacional.

O profissional terá interação constante com áreas de negócio, tecnologia e parceiros, conduzindo análises funcionais, workshops de levantamento de requisitos e garantindo a correta implementação das funcionalidades da plataforma.

Principais Responsabilidades

• Atuar como consultor funcional sênior em iniciativas de melhoria contínua e sustentação de soluções Salesforce Field Service.

• Levantar, analisar e documentar requisitos de negócio relacionados à operação de Field Service e gestão de equipes de campo.

• Configurar e evoluir funcionalidades da plataforma, incluindo Service Territories, Work Orders, Service Appointments e Work Types.

• Definir e implementar regras de agendamento, políticas de scheduling e mecanismos de otimização de rotas e agendas.

• Atuar na integração do Salesforce Field Service com outros módulos da plataforma e sistemas corporativos.

• Conduzir workshops funcionais com áreas de negócio para entendimento de processos operacionais e identificação de oportunidades de melhoria.

• Elaborar documentação funcional, especificações e fluxos de processo relacionados às soluções implementadas.

• Apoiar testes funcionais, homologação e implantação de novas funcionalidades.

• Garantir alinhamento entre requisitos de negócio, arquitetura da solução e boas práticas da plataforma Salesforce.

• Atuar em projetos com alta volumetria operacional e ambientes com múltiplas integrações.

Competências Técnicas Requeridas

• Experiência sólida em Salesforce, com atuação em projetos de implementação e evolução da plataforma.

• Conhecimento aprofundado do Salesforce Field Service.

• Experiência com os seguintes componentes da solução: Service Territories, Work Orders, Service Appointments, Work Types, Scheduling Policies, mecanismos de Optimization e Dispatch.

• Experiência na modelagem de processos operacionais de Field Service.

• Conhecimento em integração de Salesforce com sistemas corporativos.

• Experiência em levantamento de requisitos e documentação funcional de soluções.

• Capacidade de análise de processos operacionais complexos e definição de melhorias sistêmicas.

Diferenciais

• Certificação Salesforce Administrator.

• Certificação Salesforce Field Service Consultant.

• Experiência em projetos nos setores de utilities e commodities (energia, gás, água ou telecomunicações).

• Vivência em ambientes regulados ou operações de campo com grande escala operacional.

Formação

• Ensino superior completo em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia, Administração ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência

• Experiência comprovada como Consultor Funcional Sênior em projetos Salesforce.

• Atuação prática em projetos envolvendo Salesforce Field Service.

Maiores detalhes serão fornecidos durante a entrevista técnica com o cliente.
