title: Representante de desenvolvimento de vendas
description:
SOBRE A LETS

A LETS é uma empresa de tecnologia que atua na integração de canais de venda com operadores logísticos, potencializando resultados de negócios por meio de soluções inovadoras. Nosso sistema SaaS, chamado Max, é a espinha dorsal que conecta varejistas, operadores logísticos e canais de venda de forma eficiente e automatizada, oferecendo uma experiência simplificada e eficaz para todos os envolvidos. Nossa missão é desenvolver soluções tecnológicas inovadoras que maximizem o desempenho e a eficiência dos negócios, capacitando empresas a alcançar resultados excepcionais.

Estamos em fase de expansão comercial e buscamos uma pessoa SDR Outbound para explorar e testar nosso motor de prospecção ativa. Aqui, você não vai só “bater lista”: você vai ajudar a construir processo, validar ICP, testar mensagens e gerar pipeline real para o time de Closers.

ATIVIDADES:

  • Explorar e testar rotinas de prospecção outbound (cold calls, e-mails, LinkedIn e outras frentes);
  • Construir e otimizar cadências multicanal, ajustando abordagem por segmento/ICP;
  • Criar e iterar copys e mensagens personalizadas, aumentando taxas de resposta, conexão e conversão em reunião;
  • Pesquisar contas e contatos (account research) para gerar contexto e relevância na abordagem;
  • Qualificar leads com critério (fit + timing + dor + potencial), gerando oportunidades consistentes para os Closers;
  • Executar handover estruturado: garantir passagem com contexto, próximos passos, dores mapeadas e hipóteses validadas;
  • Manter o CRM (HubSpot) como fonte de verdade: higiene de dados, tracking de atividades, etapas e motivos de perda;
  • Reportar aprendizados do campo e ajudar a refinar continuamente o ICP, os gatilhos de compra e o playbook de outbound;
  • Acompanhar métricas do funil (resposta, conexão, reuniões, no-show, conversão por etapa) e propor experimentos com base em dados;
  • Atuar com boas práticas de conformidade (ex.: LGPD) na abordagem e registro de informações.

REQUISITOS:

  • Experiência prática com prospecção outbound e abordagem fria (especialmente cold calls);
  • Boa condução de pitch e conversa: saber abrir, gerar curiosidade, criar valor e fazer perguntas de diagnóstico;
  • Experiência em criação/ajuste de copys e cadências por ICP (mensagens personalizadas, não genéricas);
  • Disciplina e organização para execução diária e acompanhamento de follow-ups;
  • Experiência com CRM no dia a dia (registro, pipeline, tarefas, cadências, relatórios);
  • Domínio de HubSpot (mandatório);
  • Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal, com capacidade de síntese e clareza;
  • Mentalidade de teste: conforto com iteração, métricas, hipóteses e melhoria contínua.

HABILIDADES DESEJÁVEIS:

  • Experiência em vendas para empresas SaaS B2B (ou tecnologia com ciclo consultivo);
  • Vivência prospectando decisores em operações (logística, e-commerce, supply, transporte, last mile);
  • Experiência com social selling (LinkedIn) e geração de demanda 1:1;
  • Noções de copywriting aplicado a outbound (dor, prova, objeções, CTA);
  • Familiaridade com rotinas de análise (planilhas, dashboards, leitura de funil e experimentos);
  • Experiência com WhatsApp como canal complementar (quando aplicável e com boas práticas).

BENEFÍCIOS:

  • Remuneração competitiva + participação nos resultados + variável por performance (geração de pipeline/SQLs).
  • Plano de saúde (incluindo cônjuge e filhos).
  • Licença Remunerada Anual
  • Licença Maternidade e Paternindade
  • Plano odontológico .
  • Seguro de vida .
  • Cartão de benefícios flexível .
  • Day Off de Aniversário.
  • Rotina com ferramentas modernas e IA ; aprendizado contínuo.
  • 100% remoto (trabalhe de qualquer lugar do Brasil).

DETALHES:

  • Modelo de contratação: Pessoa Jurídica (PJ) .
  • Jornada: tempo integral, com eventuais rituais/treinamentos.
  • Local: remoto – fuso BRT (GMT-3) .
  • Todas as vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PcD).
  • Em nossos processos seletivos, não há qualquer tipo de distinção em virtude de gênero, orientação sexual, religião, crença, condição social, etnia ou raça .

COMO SE DESTACAR:

Ao se candidatar, envie exemplos e números (mesmo de projetos pessoais/experiências anteriores) que mostrem, na prática:

  • Resultados de outbound : reuniões agendadas, taxa de resposta, taxa de conexão, conversão por etapa, volume semanal e consistência;
  • Exemplos de cadências e copys que você criou (e como você adaptou por ICP);
  • Como você pesquisa contas e personaliza abordagem sem perder escala;
  • Como você lida com objeções e conduz conversas até o próximo passo com clareza;
  • Como você organiza o CRM (especialmente HubSpot): etapas, notas, tarefas, handover e higiene de dados;
  • Um caso real de melhoria: o que você testou, o que aprendeu e como isso impactou o funil ;
  • Como você aprende rápido e incorpora feedback no dia a dia (coachings, call reviews, roteiros, etc.).

title: Junior React Programmer
description:
Apgar is looking to recruit a Junior React Programmer who wants to join our growing team in Porto Alegre and be part of a group of +200 teammates who are passionate about data.

Some of the advantages of working with us..

· Flexible working schedule

· Competitive salary with benefits

· Be supported by a senior consultant (mentor) that will help in your career development

· A team spirit that will make you feel at home

· Be part of a team located in 3 different continents where diversity is as common as the air your breath

Job Overview: You will play a crucial role in developing and maintaining web applications using React and related technologies. You will work closely with our design and product teams to create user-friendly and high-performance applications. Additionally, you will be responsible for ensuring the technical feasibility of UI/UX designs and optimizing applications for maximum speed and scalability.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain web applications using React, React Remix, Tailwind, Redux, Axios, and other key JavaScript technologies.
  • Collaborate with the design and product teams to create user-friendly and high-performance applications.
  • Optimize applications for maximum speed and scalability.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.
  • Troubleshoot and debug applications.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends and technologies.

Required Experience:

  • At least two years of experience in React development.
  • At least 6 months experience in using AI Code Assistants and/or Agents, such as Github Copilot, Claude Code or similar.
  • Strong knowledge of React Remix, Tailwind, Redux, Axios, and other key JavaScript technologies.
  • Experience with version control systems such as Git.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Required Education:

  • University degree in Computer Engineering or a related field.
  • Proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

Preferred Experience:

  • Experience in developing and maintaining web applications.
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies.
  • Experience with testing frameworks and tools.
  • Strong understanding of web performance optimization techniques.

If you are passionate about creating innovative web solutions and have the experience and the will to excel as a React Developer, we encourage you to apply and join APGAR's mission to transform digital experiences through advanced web technologies.

Who we are…

Apgar is a leading company in the development and implementation of data platforms, recognized by analysts as one of the world leaders in this area.

We support our clients in their digital transformation, through the global team that has more than 200 consultants in our offices located in Europe (Portugal, UK, France, Switzerland, Cyprus), The Americas (USA and Brazil), Middle East (Lebanon) and South Asia and Oceania (Singapore and Australia).

Our consultants work on developing Master Data Management, Data Governance, Data Integration, Advanced Data Analytics and Machine Learning solutions among others.

Let's talk about your future in the world of data management software?

We firmly believe in an ethical approach to recruitment, where every candidate is treated with consideration, fairness, and transparency throughout the selection process, with the aim of respecting diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities.

description:
Cód. 58557

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Temos 2.500 funcionários e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.

  • Ei BA, venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!

- O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

- O que você deve ter?

• Experiência em Governança de Dados, Análise de Processos ou Engenharia de Requisitos , preferencialmente em empresas de grande porte.

• Vivência com ferramentas de catálogo e gestão de dados (ex.: DataPlex, OpenMetadata ou similares).

• Conhecimento em Metadados, Qualidade de Dados, Data Stewardship e MDM .

• Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) e ferramentas de gestão de demandas como ServiceNow ou similares .

• Conhecimento em SQL para análise de dados e Power BI para acompanhamento de métricas e indicadores.

- O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

- E os benefícios?

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: US Immigration Legal Intern
description:
US Immigration Legal Intern

Location: Remote, Work From Home

Reports to: Legal Team

Type: Full-Time

Are you a law student or recent graduate (or studying a related discipline) looking to get hands-on experience supporting real U.S. employment-based immigration matters?

Beyond Border is looking for a US Immigration Legal Intern to support our growing practice. In this role, you’ll work closely with our internal legal team, gaining practical exposure to how high-quality petitions are built—from intake and evidence gathering to drafting support and filing readiness.

This is a rare chance to contribute directly to an impactful problem with an experienced, dynamic team.

About Beyond Border

Beyond Border is a modern immigration platform, built by immigrants, for immigrants. Our mission is to simplify global mobility, helping 10 million individuals and families pursue their dreams, no matter where they are.

Our first product focuses on assisting Tech Founders and Operators with navigating the complex U.S. immigration system, making their relocation seamless.

We are profitable from Day 1, and are experiencing more demand than we can handle at the moment.

Our team is building quickly to serve hundreds of high growth organisations to empower them to hire talent from anywhere in the world.

Who are you?

  • Currently pursuing a law degree (JD/LLB) or a related degree (e.g., public policy, international relations, business with legal focus), or a recent graduate seeking practical experience
  • Strong written English and attention to detail (you enjoy making documents clearer, tighter, and more persuasive)
  • Highly organized with great attention to details —comfortable working with checklists, deadlines, and multiple cases

Our Team

You’ll work directly with seasoned operators who have successfully built multi-million-dollar ventures, including Wework, Glints, MoneySmart, CardUp, and Solifi.

Presente em mais de 70 países e com aproximadamente 100.000 especialistas ao redor do mundo, nossa empresa está no novo ranking Digital 100 da Forbes, uma lista das principais empresas de capital aberto que moldam o mundo digital nas áreas de Tecnologia da Informação (TI), hardware, mídia, e-commerce e telecomunicações.


Estamos buscando um Consultor Sênior Copilot para atuação em cliente Atos!


Atuação hibrida no Jabaquara.


Título: Consultor Sênior Copilot

Profissional sênior para articular estratégia e adoção de soluções Copilot (ex.: Microsoft 365/GitHub Copilot) junto às áreas de negócio. Identifica oportunidades, lidera PoCs e pilotos, traduz resultados em benefícios tangíveis e orienta times e stakeholders na implementação e governança de assistentes baseados em LLMs.



Principais atividades:

  • Conduzir mapeamento estratégico de processos e identificar casos de uso de alto impacto para Copilot.
  • Levantar requisitos com stakeholders de níveis executivo e operacional; alinhar valor de negócio e roadmap de implementação.
  • Projetar e liderar PoCs, pilotos e demonstrações executivas, traduzindo resultados técnicos em métricas de negócio (produtividade, custo, risco).
  • Definir arquitetura de soluções, integrações e padrões de prompt engineering; validar soluções com equipes de TI e segurança.
  • Medir adoção, eficácia e ROI; propor melhorias e escalonamento com base em dados.
  • Orientar e capacitar times internos e clientes por meio de treinamentos, playbooks e suporte contínuo.
  • Atuar como ponto focal para governança, privacidade, conformidade e gestão de riscos associada a LLMs e Copilot.
  • Mentorar profissionais juniores/analistas e colaborar com líderes para promover cultura de uso responsável e escalável.


Requisitos:

  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência sólida em projetos de IA/LLMs, automação ou transformação digital com interação direta com áreas de negócio.
  • Conhecimento prático de Copilot (Microsoft 365/GitHub) e conceitos de prompt engineering, APIs e integrações.
  • Familiaridade com ambientes cloud (preferência Azure), segurança de dados e requisitos de conformidade.
  • Forte capacidade de comunicação, facilitação e apresentação executiva; habilidade para traduzir tecnologia em resultados de negócio.
  • Experiência em liderar PoCs/pilotos e mensurar impacto (KPIs/ROI).


Diferenciais:

  • Certificações Microsoft (ex.: Copilot, Azure) ou Power Platform.
  • Vivência em adoção em larga escala de assistentes conversacionais/LLMs e experiência com change management.
  • Experiência prévia em consultoria estratégica ou gestão de programas.




Benefícios:

Plano de saúde

Plano odontológico

Wellhub (Gympass)

Espaço Saúde - promove a saúde e bem-estar aos nossos colaboradores, dando suporte com atendimento médico ( presencial ou online) para os funcionários e seus familiares e contamos também com os programas de bem-estar e qualidade de vida.

Terapia online

Seguro de vida em grupo

Vale refeição ou Vale alimentação

Vale transporte

Universidade corporativa (E-learning com diversos cursos disponíveis gratuitamente)

Speexx (cursar até 5 idiomas gratuitamente)

Convênio farmácias (descontos em medicamentos)

Convênio com empresas parceiras (Descontos para realização de graduação, pós-graduação, MBA e Idiomas)

Parceria com a Samsung (descontos na compra de diversos produtos)

Day off no seu aniversário

Programa de acompanhamento às gestantes (acompanhamento médico online durante a gestação para colaboradoras e cônjuges de colaboradores)

Programa Minha nova parceria de confiança (para novos pais, mães e cônjuges) - Brinde especial + Cartão presente com valor em dinheiro



Aviso de Proteção de Dados

Os dados pessoais coletados serão utilizados exclusivamente para o processo seletivo e tratados conforme os níveis de segurança adotados pela Atos.

Caso haja alguma dúvida relacionada à proteção de dados ou qualquer aspecto envolvendo o tratamento realizado, você pode entrar em contato por meio do canal:

Acesse aqui o nosso aviso de proteção de dados para saber mais sobre o tratamento de dados pessoais realizado pela Atos.

Privacy Notice


The personal data collected will be used exclusively for the recruitment process and processed according to the security guidelines introduced by Atos.

If you have any questions related to privacy or any aspect related to processing activities, you can contact us by e-mail:

Click here to access our privacy notice and to get to know more about Atos processing of personal data.

title: Content and Social Media Marketing, and Graphic Design Intern
description:
Calling All Awesome Marketing Interns!!!


Are you eager to learn and gain hands-on experience in Social Media Marketing, Content Marketing, and Graphic Design ? We’re looking for a motivated apprentice to join our team and help us create engaging content that connects with our audience.


The program is a 3-month remote internship , during which you will assist in fulfilling various digital marketing tasks for your mentioned business for 10 hours per week. This is an unpaid program whose end goal is to provide students with a higher chance of getting hired in the digital marketing space after completing our apprenticeship program.


What’s In It For You?

  • It’s (100%) fully remote position and offers flexibility in schedule.
  • You’ll have clear goals and the training resources you need to deliver.
  • Access our free courses on the platform that you can finish at your own pace.
  • 1 to 2 hours of mentorship every week.
  • Issued certification upon successfully completing the program.
  • Boost your portfolio and grow your professional network
  • Get to utilize and elevate your digital marketing skills in real projects
  • You have a high chance of being hired by your mentor during or after the apprenticeship, depending on your performance.


What You’ll Do:

  • Assist in creating engaging content for social media, blogs, newsletters, and campaigns
  • Support the design team with graphics, layouts, and visual assets
  • Help manage social media platforms and support community engagement
  • Contribute to PR initiatives, including drafting press releases and coordinating with media partners
  • Brainstorm fresh ideas for brand awareness and digital campaigns
  • Support administrative and marketing tasks as needed


What We’re Looking For:

  • Background or strong interest in Marketing, Communications, Graphic Design, PR, or related fields
  • Basic knowledge of content writing and social media strategy
  • Skills in graphic design tools (Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar)
  • Strong communication skills (written and verbal)
  • Creative mindset with a keen eye for detail
  • Ability to work independently and meet deadlines


About us:

Acadium started with the belief that anyone, anywhere, should be able to get the skills and experience they need to start their career without barriers like price, schedule, or location getting in their way. Acadium gives anyone the tools, support, and mentorship they need to launch their dream career. Acadium is the only platform that provides real work experience, accessible to everyone. Acadium began in 2017 with a team of 3 co-founders: Richard Shaw, Marco Tundo, and Moe Abbas. Since then, they’ve attracted more than 120,000 student members and over 50,000 businesses to connect through the apprenticeship marketplace. Our team is growing and looking for people who are motivated, intelligent, and committed to making education accessible to join our team.


What We Value:

  • Integrity - Be trustworthy in your actions
  • Care - Treat your teammates and our community as you would want to be treated
  • Curiosity - Ask questions. Always state your assumptions
  • Tenacity - Persevere when times are tough
  • Discipline - Be consistent in your actions
  • Ambition - Aspire to become better every day
  • Service -Serve your community to the best of your abilities.

The program is a 3-month remote internship , during which you will assist in fulfilling various digital marketing tasks for your mentioned business for 10 hours per week. This is an unpaid program whose end goal is to provide students with a higher chance of getting hired in the digital marketing space after completing our apprenticeship program.


What’s In It For You?

  • It’s (100%) fully remote position and offers flexibility in schedule.
  • You’ll have clear goals and the training resources you need to deliver.
  • Access our free courses on the platform that you can finish at your own pace.
  • 1 to 2 hours of mentorship every week.
  • Issued certification upon successfully completing the program.
  • Boost your portfolio and grow your professional network
  • Get to utilize and elevate your digital marketing skills in real projects
  • You have a high chance of being hired by your mentor during or after the apprenticeship, depending on your performance.


What You’ll Do:

  • Assist in creating engaging content for social media, blogs, newsletters, and campaigns
  • Support the design team with graphics, layouts, and visual assets
  • Help manage social media platforms and support community engagement
  • Contribute to PR initiatives, including drafting press releases and coordinating with media partners
  • Brainstorm fresh ideas for brand awareness and digital campaigns
  • Support administrative and marketing tasks as needed


What We’re Looking For:

  • Background or strong interest in Marketing, Communications, Graphic Design, PR, or related fields
  • Basic knowledge of content writing and social media strategy
  • Skills in graphic design tools (Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar)
  • Strong communication skills (written and verbal)
  • Creative mindset with a keen eye for detail
  • Ability to work independently and meet deadlines


About us:

Acadium started with the belief that anyone, anywhere, should be able to get the skills and experience they need to start their career without barriers like price, schedule, or location getting in their way. Acadium gives anyone the tools, support, and mentorship they need to launch their dream career. Acadium is the only platform that provides real work experience, accessible to everyone. Acadium began in 2017 with a team of 3 co-founders: Richard Shaw, Marco Tundo, and Moe Abbas. Since then, they’ve attracted more than 120,000 student members and over 50,000 businesses to connect through the apprenticeship marketplace. Our team is growing and looking for people who are motivated, intelligent, and committed to making education accessible to join our team.


What We Value:

  • Integrity - Be trustworthy in your actions
  • Care - Treat your teammates and our community as you would want to be treated
  • Curiosity - Ask questions. Always state your assumptions
  • Tenacity - Persevere when times are tough
  • Discipline - Be consistent in your actions
  • Ambition - Aspire to become better every day
  • Service -Serve your community to the best of your abilities.

title: Sr. Principal Backend Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $7,000 - $8,500 USD


Our partner revolutionizes clinical decision support by enhancing diagnostic accuracy and personalizing care. They modernize the diagnostic process by automating optimal lab test selection and interpretation, leveraging expert medical insights, real-world data, and artificial intelligence.


Their platform orchestrates and automates the entire diagnostic journey, reducing clinical complexity while integrating comprehensive medical histories and collective platform knowledge. They combine AI-driven clinical decision automation with instant provider payments, removing administrative and financial barriers for healthcare providers. This approach streamlines workflows, improves diagnostic accuracy, supports provider profitability, and enables clinicians to focus on delivering precise, individualized patient care.



Job Details:

We are seeking a Principal Backend Engineer to lead the design and development of our core platform services and integrations. The ideal candidate will bring deep technical expertise, systems-level thinking, and experience leading complex backend initiatives. This role is hands-on and strategic, guiding architectural decisions while mentoring engineers across the backend team.


As a principal engineer, you will influence platform design, scalability, reliability, and security at a company-wide level, working closely with product, data, and operations teams to deliver mission-critical functionality.



Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design and implementation of scalable, secure, and reliable backend platform services and APIs.
  • Define architectural standards and best practices for backend services and integrations across the company.
  • Collaborate with product managers and stakeholders to translate complex requirements into elegant technical solutions.
  • Mentor and guide backend engineers, sharing technical expertise and promoting engineering excellence.
  • Build and maintain robust integrations with third-party systems, ensuring seamless data exchange and operational reliability.
  • Identify and drive performance optimization, scalability improvements, and platform enhancements.
  • Implement advanced monitoring, alerting, and observability solutions to maintain high system availability.
  • Influence technical strategy and participate in cross-functional architectural decisions.
  • Experience with HL7/FHIR and healthcare interoperability standards is a strong plus.


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of backend development experience, with expertise in designing platform services and complex integrations.
  • Deep proficiency in Node.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, MongoDB, SQL/noSQL, and cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Strong systems thinking and experience leading technical architecture for complex domains.
  • Proven ability to mentor and guide engineering teams, setting high technical standards.
  • Experience working in complex domains, ideally U.S. Healthcare.
  • English fluency required.
  • Previous experience working at Nubank or a similar fintech is highly desirable.


Strengths We Value:

  • Strategic, systems-level thinking and ownership of end-to-end backend architecture.
  • Ability to operate in ambiguous, fast-moving environments while maintaining high reliability and correctness.
  • Mentorship and knowledge-sharing skills that elevate the engineering team.
  • Pragmatic, performance-oriented approach to platform scalability, observability, and operational resilience.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Analista de Recursos Humanos (Departamento Pessoal)
description:
DEIXE-NOS DIZER O QUE NOS TORNA GENUÍNOS…

Procuramos profissionais que queiram se reinventar a cada dia, que queiram enfrentar desafios em seu DNA e que sejam apaixonados por trabalhar com tecnologia/cibersegurança. Isso nos torna únicos e autênticos.

O que buscamos?

Procuramos um profissional Analista de Recursos Humanos , com foco em Departamento Pessoal , para compor nosso time.

O que vai fazer?

  • Realizar a gestão da folha de pagamento, encargos sociais e administração de benefícios.
  • Controlar ponto eletrônico, férias e conduzir processos de admissão e demissão.
  • Elaborar relatórios de indicadores (KPIs) e apresentações de resultados para a liderança.
  • Garantir a conformidade dos processos operacionais e suporte direto aos colaboradores em dúvidas de DP.
  • Realizar o atendimento e suporte a demandas que exijam comunicação em espanhol (nível intermediário).

O que é necessário?

  • Experiência sólida e comprovada na rotina completa de Departamento Pessoal.
  • Excel Avançado: Domínio de Procv, Somases, Tabelas Dinâmicas e elaboração de planilhas.
  • Espanhol Intermediário: Capacidade de comunicação para suporte regional.
  • Graduação completa em Recursos Humanos, Administração ou áreas correlatas.
  • Perfil analítico, proativo e com foco em organização.

Modalidade: Atuação presencial em Pinheiros/SP

title: Front-End & UI/UX Designer
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a versatile, design-driven Webflow + WordPress expert who can take a website from concept to completion.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


What You’ll Do


  • Design visually engaging websites using UI/UX best practices, accessibility standards, and performance guidelines in Figma.
  • Develop approved designs into fully-built, functional websites using Webflow and WordPress.
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and full website designs that align with user needs and client goals.
  • Use AI tools (Gemini, Claude) for web design, development, and prototyping.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to clarify requirements and ensure flawless execution.
  • Customize, refine, and optimize websites based on client feedback.
  • Stay up-to-date with digital design trends, tools, and new Figma/Webflow/WordPress capabilities.
  • Troubleshoot design-related issues and ensure smooth handoff and deployment.


What You Bring


  • 3+ years of professional experience designing using Figma AND developing websites using Webflow and WordPress.
  • A strong portfolio showcasing web design, UX/UI work, prototypes, and completed builds.
  • Proficiency in wireframing tools and design platforms (Figma, XD, Sketch, etc.).
  • Solid understanding of HTML, CSS, and responsive design principles.
  • Experience with site performance optimization and SEO-friendly design practices.
  • Ability to work effectively within a fully remote team.
  • Strong communication skills—you can articulate design decisions clearly.
  • Close attention to detail and a passion for creating elevated digital experiences.


Bonus Points


  • Experience with animations or micro-interactions in Webflow.
  • Familiarity with brand identity or graphic design.
  • Experience working in fast-paced agency settings.


Work Details


  • Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday
  • Requires a working level of written and spoken English


If you’re someone who can dream up a beautiful interface, bring it to life, and polish it until it shines, we want to hear from you!


Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Java Sênior
description:
Sobre a oportunidade

Estamos com duas posições abertas para Desenvolvedor Java Sênior, com foco em refatoração e evolução de sistemas. Buscamos profissionais com sólida experiência em desenvolvimento Full Stack e capacidade de contribuir tecnicamente em iniciativas de modernização, melhoria de performance, segurança e escalabilidade.


Responsabilidades

• Atuar em iniciativas de refatoração e melhoria contínua de sistemas legados e/ou em evolução

• Desenvolver e manter aplicações backend escaláveis, seguras e performáticas

• Construir e manter APIs RESTful com foco em segurança e eficiência

• Contribuir com boas práticas de desenvolvimento, padrões de design e clean code

• Realizar code reviews e apoiar desenvolvedores menos experientes

• Trabalhar em parceria com times de QA, DevOps e demais stakeholders


Requisitos técnicos indispensáveis

• Java 8 ou superior, com domínio de concorrência, multithreading, lambdas e streams

• Experiência sólida com Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring Security e Hibernate

• Vivência com arquitetura de microserviços

• Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais, especialmente Oracle e SQL

• Criação e consumo de APIs REST

• Experiência com testes automatizados utilizando JUnit e Mockito

• Git e boas práticas de versionamento, como GitFlow

• Conhecimento em React e ou Angular


Diferenciais

• Experiência com cloud computing, como AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud

• Vivência com ambientes de deploy, monitoramento e escalabilidade em nuvem

• Experiência com bancos de dados não relacionais


LOCALIDADE

Uberlândia/MG – Presencial

São Paulo/SP – Híbrido (2x/semana no escritório)

Outras localidades – Remoto


BENEFÍCIOS

Remuneração Variável + Participação nos Resultados (PPR)

title: Analista de Implantação | Ambientes - (Pl)
description:
Somos protagonistas na transformação digital dos meios de pagamento, somos a HST!

Desvendamos os desafios mais complexos e desde a nossa fundação temos a missão de tornar as transações eletrônicas mais seguras.

Estamos presentes em +20 Países e, dentre os nossos Clientes, estão os 8 Bancos mais importantes do Brasil e os 20 da América Latina!

São +80.000 terminais de autoatendimento; +1.000.000 autenticações de transações de compras eletrônicas ao mês; +800.000 cartões bancários com chip disponibilizados ao mês em lojas e agências bancárias; e até em 2024, foram +100 bancos utilizando nossos sistemas de emissor que permitem a tokenização de cartões COF (Card on File) e eCommerce. Isso é só uma parte dos nossos resultados, mas também é só começo!

Nos bastidores de todas as nossas conquistas está o nosso Time, que conta com +200 Pessoas envolvidas no desenvolvimento das nossas soluções. Pessoas questionadoras, curiosas, criativas, proativas, colaborativas e abertas a novas experiências!

Para saber mais sobre a HST e sobre as nossas oportunidades, acesse:

Buscamos uma pessoa Analista de Implantação | Ambientes (Pleno) para se unir ao nosso Time de Operations para:

  • Instalação de ambientes Containerizados;
  • Aplicação de GMUDs nos ambientes;
  • Participação em Certificação;
  • Instalação de ambientes on-premises;
  • Instalação de ambientes SaaS;
  • Validação de vulnerabilidades;
  • Suporte de ambiente ao time interno;
  • Instalação de KongConfiguração de Monitoração.

Acreditamos ser importante que você já tenha passado por algumas experiências e que também tenha os seguintes conhecimentos:

  • Formação superior completa nas áreas de tecnologia e correlatas
  • Experiência em Docker
  • Experiência com Containers
  • Experiência atuando com API Gateway (ex: Kong, APISix, Nginx)
  • Experiência com Orquestração Swarm

Será um grande diferencial se:

  • Conhecimento em Java;
  • Conhecimento ferramentas de autenticação e gestão de identidade como Ouath2 e/ou Keycloak;
  • Conhecimento em Apache e/ou Wildfly;
  • Conhecimento ferramentas de monitoramento como Grafana e/ou Kibana;
  • Conhecimento em Portainer e/ou Harbor;
  • Conhecimento em Vault;
  • Conhecimento com produtos, ou com os conceitos relacionados com meios de pagamento.

O que oferecemos?

A HST é uma empresa certificada GPTW! Oferecemos a oportunidade de crescimento em um ambiente de desafios em que a contrapartida de cada Pessoa equivale ao tamanho da sua vontade de crescer !

  • Contratação em regime CLT;
  • Atuação 100% Remota;
  • Horário flexível;
  • Oportunidade de crescimento, através do contínuo desenvolvimento, tanto técnico quanto pessoal;
  • Temos programas de desenvolvimento destinado às novas lideranças;
  • 10% das horas mensais, podem ser dedicadas para aprender algo novo;
  • Day-Off no mês do aniversário;
  • Ajuda de Custo Home Office;
  • Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Ampliadas;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • WellHub (antiga Gympass);
  • Convênio médico;
  • Convênio odontológico;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição;
  • Vale Transporte ou estacionamento;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Seguro de Vida.

Prezamos por um bom ambiente de trabalho que contribua para as pessoas evoluírem e se sentirem acolhidas, livres, autênticas e à vontade para demonstrarem suas habilidades! Apoiamos a diversidade e não temos espaço para qualquer tipo de discriminação!

Estamos presentes em +20 Países e, dentre os nossos Clientes, estão os 8 Bancos mais importantes do Brasil e os 20 da América Latina!

São +80.000 terminais de autoatendimento; +1.000.000 autenticações de transações de compras eletrônicas ao mês; +800.000 cartões bancários com chip disponibilizados ao mês em lojas e agências bancárias; e até em 2024, foram +100 bancos utilizando nossos sistemas de emissor que permitem a tokenização de cartões COF (Card on File) e eCommerce. title: Bilingual Accounting Specialist
description:
We’re Hiring: Remote Bilingual Accounting & Administrative Specialist

MasterPro Installs is seeking a detail-oriented and reliable Accounting & Administrative Specialist to join our remote team. This role is ideal for professionals based in  Brazil who have experience with U.S. accounting standards ,  QuickBooks , and operational financial administration.

As we continue to grow across North America, we’re looking for someone who thrives in a collaborative environment and can deliver  accurate financial data, organized records, and strong administrative support that help leadership make informed decisions.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Accounting & Finance

  • Manage daily accounting operations, including  accounts payable and accounts receivable
  • Prepare and send invoices to clients and track collections
  • Perform  bank and credit card reconciliations and investigate discrepancies
  • Maintain accurate  general ledger entries
  • Assist with budget preparation, financial forecasting, and cash flow tracking
  • Prepare monthly financial reports and support year-end accounting processes
  • Conduct  internal reviews of financial data to ensure compliance and accuracy

Payroll & Financial Administration

  • Manage and process  payroll preparation and payroll reports
  • Coordinate payroll data with external payroll providers when necessary
  • Maintain organized financial and payroll records
  • Track contractor payments and verify payment documentation
  • Assist with expense tracking and financial documentation

Administrative & Operational Support

  • Support  financial documentation, contracts, and internal administrative processes
  • Maintain organized accounting files and digital records
  • Assist leadership with financial insights and operational reports
  • Coordinate with internal departments to ensure accurate billing and financial reporting

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3+ years of professional accounting or financial administration experience
  • Proficiency in QuickBooks (Online and/or Desktop)
  • Practical knowledge of U.S. GAAP and accounting processes
  • Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, VLOOKUP, financial analysis)
  • Experience with  invoicing, payroll coordination, and financial reconciliation
  • Excellent attention to detail and strong problem-solving skills
  • Professional English communication skills
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while meeting deadlines

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Fully remote position with flexible hours
  • Opportunity to work directly with a U.S.-based leadership team
  • Exposure to multi-state operations and international business
  • Growth potential within a rapidly expanding company

If you're an  accounting professional in Brazil with strong command of  U.S. accounting standards and administrative finance operations , we’d love to hear from you.

  Apply now or send your CV and a brief introduction.

title: Direct Response Video Editor
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Build the creative engine behind performance.

Portent Brands is a holding company scaling a portfolio of healthcare and ecommerce brands through performance creative and paid growth. We build brands that win at the unit economics level—and great creative is central to how we do it.

As our DTC Video Editor, you’ll own the full lifecycle of paid video creative across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and Google. You’ll work directly with our Creative Lead and Head of Growth—taking briefs from concept to final ad independently, then iterating fast based on what the data says.

This isn’t a brand-only role. Performance, output velocity, and creative precision are the metrics that matter here. You’ll use AI tools to compress production timelines, leverage motion design to elevate hooks, and bring a direct-response instinct to every cut.

Over time, you’ll become a core creative engine across Growth, CRO, and Product—shaping how our brands convert at scale.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Own the output. Drive the numbers.

  • DTC Video Editing: Edit and ship conversion-focused video ads for Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and Google. Every cut has a performance objective.
  • Motion Design: Build sharp animations and motion graphics that reinforce hooks, brand identity, and storytelling clarity.
  • Creative Variations: Produce fast, high-quality iterations across hooks, angles, formats, pacing, and lengths to fuel continuous testing.
  • AI-Powered Production: Actively use AI video, voice, image, and asset generation tools to move from concept to finished ad in hours—not days.
  • Data-Driven Editing: Review performance metrics (thumb-stop rate, hold rate, CTR, ROAS) and translate insights directly into creative decisions.
  • A/B Testing: Run structured creative experiments and iterate quickly based on results.
  • Optimization: Continuously sharpen pacing, copy overlays, hooks, captions, structure, sound design, and visual clarity.
  • Trend Awareness: Stay current on paid social trends, platform best practices, and emerging editing and AI tools.

WHAT YOU BRING

Skills that ship.

  • Experience: 3+ years editing high-performing DTC paid social ads. Strong portfolio of Meta and TikTok creatives required.
  • Editing Tools: Expert in Adobe Premiere Pro, Capcut, Davinci Resolve. Solid working knowledge of After Effects and Photoshop.
  • Motion Design: Strong command of animation, typography, transitions, sound design, pacing, color, and visual storytelling.
  • Performance Mindset: You understand what makes a direct-response ad work—hooks, clarity, messaging hierarchy, pacing, and CTA structure.
  • AI Fluency: Comfortable using AI tools daily as part of your production stack, not as a novelty.
  • Output Velocity: Able to manage multiple edits simultaneously, hit deadlines, and sustain high-quality output at scale.
  • Captions & Copy: Writes and applies accurate, compelling English captions that reinforce messaging and hooks.
  • Execution: Takes a brief to final cut independently. Moves fast without losing craft.
  • Ownership: Finds what’s missing, fixes it, and keeps work moving without being asked.
  • Collaboration: Works fluidly with the team. Takes direct feedback and turns it around fast.
  • AI Video Tools: Hands-on experience with AI-native video editing or automation tools.
  • Creative Strategy: Familiarity with direct-response creative frameworks, hook testing, and angle development.
  • Industry: Experience with DTC, healthcare, wellness, or weight-loss brands.
  • High-Volume Teams: Background in high-throughput creative environments where output volume is tied directly to performance.

NICE TO HAVE

Bonus points.

  • Industry: Experience with DTC, healthcare, wellness, or weight-loss brands.

Compensation:

  • Base salary of $1,250 per month.
  • Performance incentive based on creative performance
  • OTE $5,000 per month

title: Risk Control Analyst
description:
Job Responsibilities

  • Investigate and analyze various risk behaviors, including fraud, phishing, and account theft , and take appropriate actions to reduce user losses and improve user satisfaction.
  • Continuously monitor user behavior and prepare investigation reports for identified risk cases.
  • Identify potential risk patterns, maintain a case database , and summarize behavioral characteristics.
  • Detect data anomalies through risk management and real-time monitoring , and coordinate with relevant teams to prevent potential losses.
  • Monitor and manage daily risk control processes to ensure the security and compliance of account activities.
  • Conduct regular reconciliation operations to ensure account balances match actual assets, identifying and resolving discrepancies.
  • Analyze existing risk management processes and policies , and provide recommendations for improvement.
  • Facilitate effective communication with internal departments and external partners to ensure timely information flow.
  • Independently handle unexpected issues and propose effective solutions.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or above .
  • 1–3 years of experience in risk investigation and analysis.
  • Experience in anti-fraud, AML, settlement, or reconciliation in payment institutions, exchanges, banks, or related industries is preferred.
  • Data analysis experience is a plus.
  • Strong communication and written skills , with the ability to collaborate across teams.
  • Strong logical thinking and analytical ability , capable of breaking down complex data.
  • Fluency in Chinese is required.

Buscamos um(a) Consultor(a) Funcional Sênior com sólida experiência em Salesforce e forte atuação em projetos de Field Service. A posição exige perfil consultivo e analítico, capaz de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções funcionais estruturadas no ecossistema Salesforce, atuando em ambientes corporativos complexos e de alta criticidade operacional.


O profissional terá interação constante com áreas de negócio, tecnologia e parceiros, conduzindo análises funcionais, workshops de levantamento de requisitos e garantindo a correta implementação das funcionalidades da plataforma.

• Configurar e evoluir funcionalidades da plataforma, incluindo Service Territories, Work Orders, Service Appointments e Work Types.

• Definir e implementar regras de agendamento, políticas de scheduling e mecanismos de otimização de rotas e agendas.

• Atuar na integração do Salesforce Field Service com outros módulos da plataforma e sistemas corporativos.

• Conduzir workshops funcionais com áreas de negócio para entendimento de processos operacionais e identificação de oportunidades de melhoria.

• Elaborar documentação funcional, especificações e fluxos de processo relacionados às soluções implementadas.

• Apoiar testes funcionais, homologação e implantação de novas funcionalidades.

• Garantir alinhamento entre requisitos de negócio, arquitetura da solução e boas práticas da plataforma Salesforce.

• Atuar em projetos com alta volumetria operacional e ambientes com múltiplas integrações.


Competências Técnicas Requeridas

• Experiência sólida em Salesforce, com atuação em projetos de implementação e evolução da plataforma.

• Conhecimento aprofundado do Salesforce Field Service.

• Experiência com os seguintes componentes da solução: Service Territories, Work Orders, Service Appointments, Work Types, Scheduling Policies, mecanismos de Optimization e Dispatch.

• Experiência na modelagem de processos operacionais de Field Service.

• Conhecimento em integração de Salesforce com sistemas corporativos.

• Experiência em levantamento de requisitos e documentação funcional de soluções.

• Capacidade de análise de processos operacionais complexos e definição de melhorias sistêmicas.

• Certificação Salesforce Field Service Consultant.

• Vivência em ambientes regulados ou operações de campo com grande escala operacional.



Formação

• Ensino superior completo em Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia, Administração ou áreas correlatas.


Experiência

• Experiência comprovada como Consultor Funcional Sênior em projetos Salesforce.

• Atuação prática em projetos envolvendo Salesforce Field Service.

Planejamos, construímos e comercializamos imóveis com excelência no padrão construtivo e de forma sustentável.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a skilled Data Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Node.js and TypeScript, combined with experience in data engineering, database management, and data modeling. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to design, implement, and optimize scalable data solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Develop, maintain, and optimize backend services using Node.js and TypeScript.

Design, implement, and maintain databases and data pipelines.

Perform data modeling, data transformation, and integration between systems.

Collaborate with data architects, analysts, and software engineers to ensure high-quality data solutions.

Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize data workflows for performance and scalability.

Ensure compliance with data governance and security standards.

Required Skills & Experience

6+ years of experience in software development, with a strong focus on Node.js and TypeScript.

Hands-on experience with databases (SQL and NoSQL) and data modeling.

title: Senior Go Engineer
description:
Own your future

Our culture isn’t something people join, it’s something they build and shape. We believe that every person deserves to be heard and empowered. If you’re on the fence about whether you’re a fit, we say go for it. Let’s build something great together.

Must have

  • Strong proficiency in modern WEB stack based on Go.
  • Experience delivering a public API, REST API, Open API specs.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms, preferably AWS.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate ideas and collaborate effectively across teams.
  • A proactive mindset: able to propose new ideas, contribute to creative problem-solving, and drive innovative features.
  • Proven ability to balance technical expertise with interpersonal skills. Success in this role requires more than coding; it requires strong teamwork, adaptability, and initiative.
  • Upper-Intermediate+ English and the ability to communicate effectively with international teams.

Key responsibilities

  • Owning the end-to-end user experience of the platform, ensuring reliability and performance meet user expectations.
  • Making technical decisions and tradeoffs to reduce operational overhead and improve system stability.
  • Implementing observability solutions to increase visibility into system behavior and user experience.
  • Maintaining and enhancing product capabilities.

title: Head of Analytics & Business Intelligence
description:
About Warmy :)

Warmy.io enhances email deliverability by optimizing domain and IP reputation, ensuring emails land in inboxes instead of spam folders. Our advanced platform simplifies email warming using a unique email seed list.


With integrations like Google Postmaster Tools, Warmy provides actionable insights for superior email performance. Catering to a global audience, Warmy supports email warming in over 30 languages and offers free tools for marketers, such as the Email Deliverability Test and SPF/DMARC Record Generators. Warmy is designed to streamline email deliverability, allowing users to focus on meaningful audience engagement.


Role Description

We are looking for a Head of Analytics & Business Intelligence to own and manage all company analytics. This role is responsible for building a clear view of the business through data, monitoring key metrics on a daily basis, and translating numbers into actionable insights for leadership.

The ideal candidate is someone who not only builds dashboards but actively tracks performance, identifies trends, and provides clear conclusions and recommendations that help the company make better decisions.

You will work closely with leadership, marketing, product, sales, and customer success to ensure the company operates in a data-driven way .


Responsabilites:

  • Own the company’s analytics strategy and data visibility across all departments.
  • Design, build, and maintain dashboards and reports that track key company metrics.
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across all systems.


KPI Monitoring

Continuously track and analyze key business metrics including:

Revenue & Financial Metrics

  • MRR / ARR
  • Revenue growth
  • Churn
  • Net Revenue Retention (NRR)
  • Expansion revenue

Marketing Performance

  • Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC)
  • Channel performance
  • Attribution analysis
  • Funnel conversion rates
  • Campaign performance

Product Analytics

  • User activation
  • Feature adoption
  • Product usage trends
  • Customer retention and engagement

Sales Analytics

  • Pipeline performance
  • Conversion rates
  • Sales cycle length
  • Revenue forecasting

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or data analysis .
  • Experience working in SaaS or technology companies .
  • Strong understanding of SaaS metrics and revenue models .
  • Proven ability to translate data into clear insights and strategic recommendations.
  • Experience building dashboards and analytics systems.


Skills:

Experience with several of the following tools is preferred:

  • BI and analytics platforms (Looker, Tableau, Metabase, Power BI, etc.)
  • SQL and data querying
  • Data visualization and dashboard creation
  • CRM analytics (HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar)
  • Marketing analytics platforms
  • Product analytics tools (Mixpanel, Amplitude, or similar)


Key Qualities

  • Highly analytical and detail-oriented
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable insights
  • Strong communication skills
  • Proactive mindset and ownership of results


What Success Looks Like in This Role

  • Leadership has clear visibility into company performance at all times .
  • Key dashboards track the company’s most important metrics.
  • Data insights lead to better strategic decisions and faster growth .
  • The organization becomes increasingly data-driven in how it operates .

title: AI-Augmented Software Engineer
description:
AI-Augmented Software Engineer

Python | JavaScript | Cloud | AI Coding Agents

We are looking for a Software Engineer who builds software with AI as a core part of the development workflow.

This role is not for engineers who occasionally use Copilot . We are looking for developers who already work in an AI-augmented engineering environment , using tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or other AI coding agents to significantly accelerate development.

You should be comfortable allowing AI to generate large portions of code , while maintaining full responsibility for architecture, quality, and system reliability .

  • Impact: Help shape the careers of students from top schools, as well as students who come from diverse backgrounds

Senior Clinical Trial Manager (CTM) – Remoto | Brasil

Buscamos um/a Senior Clinical Trial Manager (CTM) para atuar de forma remota, com disponibilidade para viagens eventuais ao exterior. Esta posição estratégica é responsável pela liderança do gerenciamento de estudos clínicos nacionais e internacionais, desde a concepção até o encerramento, garantindo a excelência em todas as etapas.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Gestão integral dos estudos clínicos: concepção do protocolo, feasibility, startup, contratos, orçamentos, acompanhamento de dados, encerramento e suporte à análise e interpretação.
  • Engajamento estratégico com stakeholders e equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Supervisão de documentação regulatória, TMF, progresso de estudo e orçamentos.
  • Contribuição relevante nas submissões regulatórias e revisão de documentos-chave.
  • Identificação de riscos operacionais, implementação de boas práticas e melhorias contínuas.


Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em área científica (desejável pós-graduação ou especialização).
  • Experiência sólida (>5 anos) em gerenciamento de estudos clínicos, em patrocinadoras ou CROs.
  • Profundo conhecimento de operações clínicas, ICH, GCP e requisitos regulatórios internacionais.
  • Vivência no direcionamento de equipes e interface entre áreas como Qualidade, Dados, Estatística, Medical Writing, Suprimentos e Finanças.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente.


Perfil desejado:

  • Proatividade, organização, alta capacidade analítica e habilidade para atuar em ambientes dinâmicos.
  • Comunicação clara e habilidade para construir relacionamentos internos e externos.
  • Ética, profissionalismo e compromisso com a entrega de resultados de alta qualidade.

title: Merchant Operation
description:
Responsibilities

  • Brand Solutions: Conduct brand research and analysis to deliver comprehensive solutions; establish mechanisms and standards to refine lean business models, ensuring rapid business expansion.
  • Store Operations: Oversee online store operations management and leverage product tools to drive rapid business scale-up; take accountability for the operational results of brand stores.
  • Data & Strategy: Conduct merchant data analysis and performance reviews; timely adjust operational strategies and plans based on data performance, brand feedback, and market dynamics.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Lead collaboration across Offline teams, KA/SMB, User Growth, and Delivery teams; coordinate to achieve the optimal balance between scale, user experience, and P&L for merchant brands.
  • Innovation: Continuously innovate and iterate business models based on market and competitive dynamics; seek solutions that maximize benefits for brands, users, and the platform.

Job Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or above; no specific major required.
  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in product operations or merchant operations.
  • Industry Knowledge: Familiar with merchant operation processes and rules in the Local Services industry; strong data analysis and problem-solving skills.
  • Soft Skills: Excellent communication and teamwork skills; ability to effectively manage the team and drive execution.
  • Mindset: Agile thinking, clear logic, and the ability to work under pressure.

title: Concierge
description:
Somos uma EdTech com foco em processos de saúde. Temos o compromisso de melhorar a educação médica do Brasil, com o propósito de melhorar o cuidado ao paciente em todos os níveis de acesso do sistema de saúde. Somos também um time que acredita a inovação e a tecnologia devem ser aliadas da educação em um meio que está em constante atualizações, por isso, estamos cada vez mais ampliando as oportunidades de talentos na equipe, com desejo de transformar, melhorar e ativamente criar este ecossistema conosco.


O Concierge é peça-chave para garantir uma jornada de excelência aos nossos alunos, realizando atendimentos de forma presencial e on-line.


Responsabilidades:

  • Atendimento receptivo, tanto presencial como on-line;
  • Registro dos atendimentos;
  • Entrega de KPIs, de acordo com a operação;
  • Tratamento das necessidades dos clientes por meio dos sistemas disponíveis;
  • Atendendo as solicitações de forma rápida e eficaz, sempre buscando oferecer a melhor experiência para o cliente;
  • Promover a máxima satisfação por meio de um atendimento especializado;
  • Realizar chamada de vídeo com alunos, quando necessário para explicar/apresentar a plataforma.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Conhecimento em informática (Pacote Office);
  • Experiência anterior em atendimento ao cliente;
  • Boa comunicação escrita e oral;
  • Facilidade na interpretação de texto;
  • Perfil analítico e comunicativo;
  • Facilidade em trabalhar em equipe, com metas e prazos;
  • Facilidade em utilizar sistemas de atendimento e ferramentas de gestão de chamados;
  • Capacidade de solucionar problemas de forma rápida e eficaz, mantendo a calma em situações desafiadoras;
  • Empatia e paciência para lidar com diferentes perfis de clientes;
  • Organização e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Proatividade, vontade de aprender e se desenvolver.


Desejável:

  • Curso ou experiência com Customer Experience (CX) e/ou Customer Success (CS).


Benefícios :

description:
Nascida da necessidade do mercado de profissionais de TI e de serviços sob demanda, a HUMATECH atua internacionalmente em todo o continente americano, engajando recursos especializados para posições e projetos de nossos parceiros.


JOB OPPORTUNITY!


Nosso time está procurando um(a) Especialista em ACTIVE DIRECTORY com as seguintes característica:


Responsabilidades:


Administrar, projetar e implementar soluções em ambientes Microsoft 365 e Active Directory;

Atuar em projetos de migração (AD e O365), garantindo segurança e governança de identidade;

Automatizar processos e rotinas utilizando PowerShell;

Colaborar com a equipe no desenho de soluções em Azure, Active Directory,Exchange Online, MS Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive e App Proxy;

Realizar auditorias, troubleshooting e suporte em ambientes complexos.



✅ Requisitos Técnicos:

- 7 a 8 anos de experiência em produtos Office 365 (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, etc.);

- ⁠Domínio em Active Directory, DNS, AD Trusts, ferramentas de migração do AD e Quest;

- ⁠Experiência com ferramentas de gerenciamento do AD (auditoria, autoatendimento, etc.);

- ⁠Forte conhecimento em PowerShell (gerenciamento e automação);

- ⁠Histórico comprovado em projetos de migração de Active Directory e O365;

- ⁠Inglês avançado (capacidade de manter conversação).



➡️ Informações da vaga 


- Tipo de vínculo: Modelo PJ;

- Horário de trabalho: Horário comercial;

- Local de trabalho: Remoto.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
TITAN is a no-code, web-based, fast-paced, growing startup within the Salesforce ecosystem. Our platform allows for seamless form creation, data collection, and workflow automation, all with no coding required. We are looking to hire Customer Success Managers to join our growing Customer Success team in North America.


As a Customer Success Manager , you'll manage client onboarding, expansions, and renewals while leveraging technical expertise with a strategic business mindset to build strong customer relationships and identify growth opportunities. Join our innovative CS team to drive success and collaborate with Sales, Product, Solutions, and Support teams.


Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customers, ensuring seamless onboarding, training, and adoption.
  • Lead discovery meetings with key users and stakeholders from customers and partners to position Titan as a core system and focus on maximizing its value.
  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders to drive engagement and long-term success.
  • Identify upsell and expansion opportunities by aligning product capabilities with customer needs.
  • Analyze customer usage data to proactively address risks and drive retention strategies.
  • Conduct regular business reviews and proactively address issues to drive customer satisfaction and retention.


Requirements:

  • 2-4 years of proven experience as a Customer Success Manager or Technical Account Manager in a SaaS company (must ).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong customer-facing abilities, including a willingness to meet clients onsite and lead business discussions.
  • Experience in identifying upsell/cross-sell opportunities and working closely with Sales.
  • Hands-on experience with onboarding and implementation processes of Salesforce or other CRMs - a must .
  • A can-do approach with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work under pressure.
  • Fluent in English; additional languages are a plus.
  • Ability to work remotely across EST/PST time zones.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, Business or equivalent experience.


Why Join TITAN ?:

  • Work with a dynamic and innovative team in a fast-growing SaaS startup
  • Collaborate with industry-leading clients and gain exposure to cutting-edge technologies
  • Enjoy the flexibility of remote work and a healthy work-life balance
  • Competitive compensation package and opportunities for professional growth and development

title: Back-end Engineer / Platform Engineer
description:
Job Title: Back-end Engineer / Platform Engineer

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Mode: Contract


Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Back-end / Platform Engineer to design and build scalable backend services and APIs. The ideal candidate will have strong experience with Node.js, TypeScript, GraphQL, and API development , along with experience working with cloud platforms and modern containerized environments.


Mandatory Skills

  • GraphQL
  • API Development (GraphQL & REST)
  • Node.js
  • TypeScript


Required Experience

  • 6+ years of experience in software engineering or backend development
  • Strong experience building and maintaining APIs using GraphQL and REST
  • Solid understanding of database design and optimization (SQL & NoSQL)
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or OCI
  • Experience with containers and orchestration tools (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Proficiency in backend technologies such as Node.js, Java (Spring Boot), or Python


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain data-driven APIs using GraphQL and REST
  • Build and optimize backend services interacting with relational and NoSQL databases
  • Design and manage GraphQL schemas, resolvers, and API performance
  • Collaborate with data, product, and application teams to define data access patterns
  • Implement API security, versioning, and governance best practices
  • Deploy and manage services using Docker and Kubernetes
  • Work with AWS or OCI cloud services to build scalable and reliable systems
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize application and database performance
  • Participate in architecture discussions and mentor junior engineers

title: Clinical & Marketing Specialist – Interventional Cardiology (Brazil)
description:
About us


BrosMed is the largest balloon catheter research, development, production, and sales enterprise in China, possessing globally leading balloon catheter technology and manufacturing capabilities. Since its establishment in 2012, the company has grown to over 1,500 staffs in scale, with R&D centers, operational centers, and production bases established worldwide.


Responsibilities


-Provide on-site clinical support during interventional procedures, including PTCA, PTA, and interventional accessories, with a strong focus on coronary specialty balloons such as POT balloons, Wedge NC scoring balloons, and Alveo CTO balloons.

-Support distributors and physicians during case coverage, product demonstrations, and technical guidance in catheterization laboratories.

-Manage and develop key hospitals and key opinion leaders (KOLs) within assigned regions, ensuring continuous clinical follow-up and strong professional relationships.

-Work closely with the sales team and distributors to support regional sales objectives; proactively assist in product positioning, clinical adoption, and procedure planning.

-Participate in and support major medical congresses, workshops, live cases, and training programs, including booth support and academic promotion.

-Deliver clinical training and product education to distributors, sales representatives, and healthcare professionals.

-Collect and provide market intelligence, competitive insights, and clinical feedback from the field to support marketing and product strategy.

-Assist in the launch of new products and support post-market clinical follow-up.

-Ensure all activities comply with local regulations, company policies, and compliance standards.



Qualifications


Language proficiency:

High-level command of a local language

the ability to communicate in English for basic work-related communications (for collaboration with headquarters).

Industry background:

Relevant experience in healthcare sectors such as medical practitioners, nurses, pharmaceutical representatives, medical device/pharmaceutical distributors;

preference given to candidates familiar with local healthcare systems, distribution channels, and client needs.

Core qualities:

Passionate about sales work, goal-oriented, results-driven;

strong self-motivation and adaptability to remote work modes;

excellent communication skills and customer service awareness.

description:

BRAZIL ONLY - NO APPLICATIONS FROM OTHER REGIONS WILL BE ACCEPTED

Professional working proficiency in PORTUGUESE

Role Overview

Global Drinks Intel is recruiting independent international agents to introduce and promote the Global Drinks Awards within their local drinks industry markets. The role focuses on encouraging distilleries, spirits brands and beverage producers to enter their products into the awards programme.

Agente Internacional da Indústria de Bebidas Alcoólicas (Somente Comissão) BRASIL

SOMENTE BRASIL - NÃO SERÃO ACEITAS CANDIDATURAS DE OUTRAS REGIÕES

Proficiência profissional em PORTUGUÊS

Descrição da Função

A Global Drinks Intel está recrutando agentes internacionais independentes para apresentar e promover o Global Drinks Awards em seus respectivos mercados locais da indústria de bebidas. A função concentra-se em incentivar destilarias, marcas de bebidas alcoólicas e produtores de bebidas a inscreverem seus produtos no programa de premiação.

Organisation

Global Drinks Intel is a B2B publisher providing market intelligence, analysis and industry insight to the global drinks industry. The company is based in London.

Global Drinks Intel is also the organizer of the Global Drinks Awards, an international awards platform recognizing excellence across spirits, RTD and no/low alcohol categories.

What You Will Be Promoting

The Global Drinks Awards recognizes excellence across spirits, RTD and no/low alcohol products. Entries are submitted by producers globally and judged by international drinks industry professionals.

Applicants should send a short introduction outlining their drinks industry experience and existing producer relationships and email your CV (IN ENGLISH) to:

James Houlder , Commercial Director , Global Drinks Intel

Email:

· Existing relationships with spirits producers or distilleries

· Experience within the beverage alcohol industry

· Comfortable working independently on a commission structure

· Strong network within the local drinks industry

Commission Structure

· 20% commission on net receipts up to £9,999 per calendar year

· 25% commission on net receipts above £10,000

· Commission payable only once entry payments have cleared

Key Responsibilities

· Introduce the Global Drinks Awards to distilleries, spirits brands and beverage producers in your territory

· Encourage and support producers to submit product entries

· Identify new brands and producers suitable for the awards

· Maintain an up-to-date territory database of contacts

· Submit a weekly spreadsheet of companies contacted

· Share market insights from your local drinks industry

· Independent spirits consultants

· Freelance sales agents in the drinks sector

· Trade show representatives or regional industry connectors

title: Camunda 8 Developer
description:
Corus Consulting is a consulting firm with more than 15 years of experience with different clients worldwide; we have presence in Europe, United States, Asia and Mexico.

We are looking for your talent to work as:


Camunda 8 Developer


About the role:

We are seeking a highly skilled Camunda Developer with knowledge in the 8th version, to join our team supporting a customer in the banking sector.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop new components, maintain and evolve existent ones according to the team priorities and product roadmap.
  • Active role on team software quality assurance, best practices and agile methodology.
  • Take responsibility of the software delivery by ensuring quality and scope expectations are met.
  • Work closely with partner technology teams and collaborate effectively.


Requirements:

  • Hand-on experience designing and implementing Camunda 8 BPMN processes.
  • Deep understanding of Java (11 or above) and Java Spring (4 or superior) and solid understanding of OO principles.
  • Solid experience Spring Boot.
  • Diligent with automated testing i.e. JUnit/Mockito/Cucumber, etc.
  • Understanding of RESTful API principles.
  • Proficiency in English (minimum B2).


Location:

  • Remote from Brazil.


Ready to bring your expertise to the next level? Apply now and join a team that's shaping the future of financial services.


Support the team and the Camunda Chapter!

title: Electrical Specialist-Projetos de Energia e Potência
description:
1) Sobre a SolutionMall

SolutionMall ( é uma plataforma global B2B que suporta projetos por meio de um fluxo online de levantamento de requisitos, matching de solução, coordenação de fornecimento e suporte de entrega .

No setor de energia, focamos em entrega em nível de sistema , com documentação estruturada para reduzir riscos e melhorar a execução.

2) Resumo da Função

Estamos contratando um(a) Energy Manager (meio período) para apoiar projetos de energia e potência no Brasil. Função orientada a projetos: estruturar requisitos, coordenar RFQs/cotações, alinhar soluções às restrições do projeto e apoiar a coordenação de entrega com as equipes SolutionMall.

Remuneração: Comissão: 2%–4% do valor do contrato (mínimo 2%) , conforme categoria e tipo de projeto.

3) Principais Responsabilidades (cenários Brasil)

A) Captura e estruturação de requisitos

● Levantar e estruturar requisitos (escopo, capacidade, site, normas, cronograma, stakeholders).

● Validar completude para reduzir retrabalho em RFQ/cotação.

Cenários comuns no Brasil:

● Projetos industrial / mineração / óleo & gás-adjacente (dependendo do projeto)

● Expansões e upgrades de distribuição elétrica MV/LV

● Necessidades de geração de backup (gerador + ATS, integração)

● Projetos com exigência de documentação técnica e compliance

B) Coordenação RFQ / Cotação

● Transformar requisitos em pacote RFQ (BOM quando necessário).

● Coordenar cotações, lead times e documentação técnica; conduzir ciclos de esclarecimento.

C) Alinhamento de solução & coordenação de entrega

● Suportar matching em MV/LV, transformadores, switchgear, proteção & controle, renováveis, armazenamento (se aplicável), monitoramento.

● Coordenar marcos e riscos (especificação, compatibilidade, prazo).

D) Tracking & feedback

● Manter tracking estruturado (etapas, bloqueadores, próximos passos).

● Compartilhar feedback de necessidades recorrentes e restrições locais.

4) Requisitos

Obrigatório: 2+ anos em coordenação de projetos energia/potência, suporte EPC/engenharia/compras ou similar; disciplina documental; português fluente (inglês = diferencial).

Diferencial: MV/LV, indústria pesada, geração backup, documentação de projeto.5) Métricas

Projetos suportados, RFQs/cotações coordenadas (qualidade), deals fechados suportados, qualidade de coordenação, disciplina de tracking.

6) Remuneração & Apoio

● Comissão: 2%–4% (mín. 2%) ; pagamento alinhado a contrato confirmado e marcos de pagamento.

● Apoio mensal USD 300–500 para colaboradores ativos (atividade mínima mensal: pacotes RFQ completos e/ou projetos avançados).

● Certificação oficial + status verificado após início efetivo da colaboração.

7) Cobertura

Brasil (foco conforme sua rede e acesso a projetos).

8) Como se candidatar (simples)

Candidate-se via LinkedIn com 1 linha de foco (ex. “MV/LV + indústria”, “backup power”, “solar C&I”), ou envie seu CV para: assunto: Energy Manager – Brasil .
